phrases.re: Scan the code with your phone's camera: it opens this Fizgig already logged in, and\s+the phone stays logged in for 30 days, so you can keep an eye on a run from anywhere\.

phrases.zh: 开始 → 图像预处理 → 标注 → 样本 → 训练，编号从顶部横排改为左侧竖排。之后用到的工具（运行与输出、工作台、分析器等）都排在它们下面。

phrases.zh: 模型训练过程中生成的预览，让你可以观察学习过程并挑选最佳检查点。

phrases.en: The same choice as the Start tab's: change it here or there.
phrases.zh: 与「开始」标签页的选择相同：可在这里或那里更改。

phrases.zh: 用训练图片中主体人物的三张照片对每张预览的人脸进行评分（ArcFace，在 CPU 上运行——训练占用 GPU）。仅衡量身份相似度：过拟合和皮肤质感仍需你自己判断。

phrases.en: Scrub this run epoch by epoch, one prompt at a time; play it, save a frame or a clip
phrases.zh: 逐个轮次、逐条提示词地浏览本次运行；播放它，保存一帧或一段片段

phrases.en: Runs Start's checks without starting: lists anything missing or wrong, else the stages a run would go through
phrases.zh: 执行「开始」的检查但不真正开始：列出任何缺失或错误，否则列出运行会经历的阶段

phrases.en: Checked like Start, then lined up: it starts when the runs before it finish
phrases.zh: 像「开始」一样检查，然后排队：当前面的运行结束后它才开始

phrases.en: Make the previews now, after the current training step, without waiting for the epoch to end
phrases.zh: 在当前训练步骤之后立即生成预览，无需等待轮次结束

phrases.en: Each training image's loss by epoch, against the rest of the dataset: which images are still being learned, which are done, and what the loss watch decided about each
phrases.zh: 按轮次显示每张训练图片相对数据集其余部分的损失：哪些图片仍在学习、哪些已完成，以及损失监控对每张图片的判断

phrases.en: Save the LoRA as it is now, after the current training step (as name-stepNNNNNNN.safetensors)
phrases.zh: 在当前训练步骤之后按当前状态保存 LoRA（文件名为 name-stepNNNNNNN.safetensors）

phrases.en: Carry on training this run on another computer running Fizgig (a pod, a laptop) while you use this one: it pauses here and resumes there, and comes back the same way

phrases.en: The base: each end's words are added after it with a space, as at the start
phrases.zh: 基础：两端的词会像开头一样，在其后加空格追加

phrases.en: Prompts the dial must not change, one a line (empty = none)
phrases.zh: 该旋钮不得更改的提示词，每行一个（留空 = 无）

phrases.en: Put back what the slider is training on now
phrases.zh: 恢复滑块当前正在训练的内容

phrases.en: The strength this LoRA is meant to be used at (not always 1.0). The block sliders are relative to it: a block at 1.0 is that block at this strength, 0.5 is half of it. The saved file keeps the LoRA's own scale, so use it at this strength and it looks exactly like the preview.
phrases.zh: 此 LoRA 预期使用的强度（不一定为 1.0）。各块滑块都相对于它：块为 1.0 表示该块按此强度，0.5 表示其一半。保存的文件保留 LoRA 自身的缩放，因此按此强度使用时效果与预览完全一致。

phrases.en: Model EQ Mode: this row becomes the model's own weights (the Model EQ LoRA set in Preferences) at strength 1 - every block slider then reads 1.0 = the stock model, below 1 turns that block's main directions down, above 1 up. Press it again for your own LoRA back.
phrases.zh: 模型均衡模式：此行变为模型自身的权重（在偏好设置中设置的 Model EQ LoRA），强度为 1——此时每个块滑块 1.0 = 原版模型，低于 1 调低该块的主要方向，高于 1 调高。再次按下可恢复你自己的 LoRA。

phrases.en: The saved epochs beside the primary, mixed as a moving average: Up to = the newest epoch in it, History = how much of the earlier ones comes with it. Block sliders apply to the whole mix; Save bakes it into one LoRA.
phrases.zh: 将主文件旁保存的各轮次按移动平均混合：Up to = 其中最新的轮次，History = 附带多少较早轮次。块滑块作用于整个混合结果；「保存」会将其烘焙为一个 LoRA。

phrases.en: The primary plus any LoRAs of this model, each at its own amount - e.g. funk 1.0 + synthwave 0.5 - then shaped with the block sliders. Save bakes it into one LoRA.
phrases.zh: 主文件加上此模型的任意 LoRA，各自以不同的量（例如 funk 1.0 + synthwave 0.5），然后用块滑块塑形。「保存」会将其烘焙为一个 LoRA。

phrases.en: Mixes the saved epochs of the primary's run (the files beside it) as an exponential moving average, live. Up to: the newest epoch in the mix. History: how much of the earlier epochs comes with it (0 = that epoch alone). The primary's block sliders apply to the whole mix, and Save bakes it into the LoRA.
phrases.zh: 实时将主文件那次运行所保存的各轮次（其旁的文件）按指数移动平均混合。Up to：混合中最新的轮次。History：附带多少较早轮次（0 = 仅该轮次）。主文件的块滑块作用于整个混合结果，「保存」会将其烘焙进 LoRA。

phrases.en: optional: a second LoRA to mix in, block by block
phrases.zh: 可选：要逐块混入的第二个 LoRA

phrases.en: Mixes the saved epochs of the donor's run (the files beside it) as an exponential moving average, live. Up to: the newest epoch in the mix. History: how much of the earlier epochs comes with it (0 = that epoch alone). The donor's block sliders apply to the whole mix, and Save bakes it into the LoRA.
phrases.zh: 实时将「提供方」那次运行所保存的各轮次（其旁的文件）按指数移动平均混合。Up to：混合中最新的轮次。History：附带多少较早轮次（0 = 仅该轮次）。提供方的块滑块作用于整个混合结果，「保存」会将其烘焙进 LoRA。
包含该 LoRA 的触发词

phrases.en: The model hears a recording (30 s of it: a piece from the start, middle and end) and makes the song sound like it - the voice, the instruments, the mix. Works with or without a song to start from.
phrases.zh: 模型听取一段录音（30 秒：开头、中间和结尾各取一段），让歌曲听起来像它——人声、乐器、混音。有无起始歌曲均可使用。

phrases.en: e.g. jazz trio, upright bass, brushed drums, warm
phrases.zh: 例如：爵士三重奏、立式贝斯、刷子鼓、温暖

phrases.en: Every step runs the model with both prompts and mixes the two: 0 = Prompt A alone, 1 = Prompt B alone. Baseline gets the same blend, so Baseline vs Tweaked still shows only the sliders. Keep Prompt A's lyrics: Prompt B changes the style while A's words are sung.
phrases.zh: 每一步都用两个提示词运行模型并混合两者：0 = 仅提示词 A，1 = 仅提示词 B。基准图使用相同的混合，因此「基准 vs 调整」仍只显示滑块的差异。保留提示词 A 的歌词：提示词 B 改变风格，而唱出的是 A 的歌词。

phrases.en: a song - any audio or video file
phrases.zh: 一首歌——任意音频或视频文件

phrases.en: Whole song: the render follows the song and/or starts from its sound (Follow, Denoise). Repaint the loop section: only the section you drag across the Tweaked waveform is made new - the rest of the song stays exactly as it is. Extend to the Length: the song carries on past its end, up to the Length setting.
phrases.zh: 整首歌：渲染跟随歌曲和/或从其声音开始（Follow、Denoise）。重绘循环段落：只有你在「调整」波形上拖选的那一段会被重新生成——歌曲其余部分保持原样。延伸到指定时长：歌曲会越过结尾继续，直到 Length 设置的长度。

phrases.en: Follow: how much of the render follows the song's melody, timing and structure - but not its sound, so the prompt and LoRA choose the voice and instruments (ACE-Step's cover mode). 0 = off; lower lets the song wander in the last steps. Denoise: start from the song's actual sound with noise added, running only the rest of the steps. Lower keeps more of the real recording; 1.0 = start from noise. They work together or alone.
phrases.zh: Follow：渲染在多大程度上跟随歌曲的旋律、节奏和结构——但不跟随其声音，因此提示词和 LoRA 决定人声和乐器（ACE-Step 的翻唱模式）。0 = 关闭；较低值让歌曲在最后几步自由发挥。Denoise：从歌曲的真实声音加噪声开始，仅运行剩余步骤。较低值保留更多真实录音；1.0 = 从噪声开始。两者可同时使用，也可单独使用。

phrases.en: How freely the new section is made. Lower holds it closer to the song around it and blends the joins more gently; higher lets it go its own way, with shorter joins. 0.5 is ACE-Step's default. Outside the section you always hear the song exactly as it was.
phrases.zh: 新段落的生成自由度。较低值使其更贴近周围的歌曲，衔接更柔和；较高值让它自由发挥，衔接更短。0.5 是 ACE-Step 的默认值。在段落之外，你听到的始终是歌曲原样。

phrases.en: It keeps the unchanged blocks' results in VRAM to replay them: turn it off if VRAM is tight.
phrases.zh: 它会把未更改块的结果保留在显存中以重放：如果显存紧张请关闭。

phrases.en: The Reference model takes up to two photos (Frames below): say <Picture 1> / <Picture 2> in the prompt for them. Switching reloads the model at the next Start / Update (about 25 s).
phrases.zh: 参考模型最多接受两张照片（见下方「帧」）：在提示词中写 <Picture 1> / <Picture 2> 来引用它们。切换会在下一次「开始/更新」时重新加载模型（约 25 秒）。

phrases.en: Sampling steps for the clip. With Turbo at 1.0, 4 steps is the fast loop; Turbo 0 needs about 20.
phrases.zh: 片段的采样步数。Turbo 为 1.0 时，4 步即可快速循环；Turbo 为 0 时需要约 20 步。

phrases.en: Strength of the built-in Turbo LoRA: 1.0 for the fast loop, 0.75 matches the in-training previews. 0 switches it off - the render is the base plus your LoRAs at the steps set. That is how you edit a Turbo LoRA: load it as the primary and set this to 0.
phrases.zh: 内置 Turbo LoRA 的强度：1.0 用于快速循环，0.75 与训练中的预览一致。0 将其关闭——渲染结果是基础模型加上你的 LoRA，使用所设步数。这就是编辑 Turbo LoRA 的方法：将其作为主文件加载，并把此项设为 0。

phrases.en: The first half of the steps (rounded down: 7 steps gives 3) render at half size, then the clip grows to full size for the rest - a faster render. The layout is worked out at half size, so a seed frames differently with it on. From Fizgig's H3 Speed Boost node (SPEED, Xiao et al. 2026, via LC Speed Boost).
phrases.zh: 前一半步数（向下取整：7 步取 3 步）以半尺寸渲染，之后片段放大到全尺寸完成剩余部分——渲染更快。构图在半尺寸下确定，因此开启后同一种子取景会不同。源自 Fizgig 的 H3 Speed Boost 节点（SPEED，Xiao 等人 2026，经由 LC Speed Boost）。

phrases.en: Put up the pass-2 estimate in the Tweaked pane while the remaining passes run
phrases.zh: 在剩余遍数运行时，于「调整」面板中显示第二遍的预估结果

phrases.en: Restores a saved setup exactly - switching model if needed, loading its LoRAs and rendering.
phrases.zh: 精确恢复已保存的设置——必要时切换模型、加载其 LoRA 并渲染。

phrases.en: Saves everything on this tab - the LoRAs, every slider and tick, the prompt, seed, length, photos and source - to one file you can load back later or share.
phrases.zh: 将本标签页的所有内容——LoRA、每个滑块和勾选、提示词、种子、时长、照片和来源——保存到一个文件，之后可重新加载或分享。

phrases.en: Keeps Baseline and Tweaked in view while you scroll to the sliders: a panel you can move and resize, or pin to the top
phrases.zh: 在滚动到滑块时保持「基准」和「调整」可见：一个可移动、可调整大小或固定到顶部的面板

phrases.en: The preview is in the panel kept in view.
phrases.zh: 预览位于保持可见的面板中。

phrases.en: Click either picture to see both full size (← → switches between them).
phrases.zh: 点击任意图片可全尺寸查看两者（← → 在它们之间切换）。

phrases.en: Paired numbers for the two renders on screen (same seed and prompt, only the blocks differ - where such measures are honest). Likeness: ArcFace similarity to your reference photo. Grid: the model's patch lattice showing through (rising = overbake). Detail: face texture energy (down = plastic, up = fried). Clipped: blown pixels. Sat: saturation.
phrases.zh: 屏幕上两个渲染结果的成对数值（相同种子和提示词，仅块不同——在这些指标可信的情况下）。Likeness：与参考照片的 ArcFace 相似度。Grid：模型的补丁网格显现程度（上升 = 过拟合）。Detail：面部纹理能量（下降 = 塑料感，上升 = 过曝）。Clipped：过曝像素。Sat：饱和度。

phrases.en: The Baseline as rendered: the LoRA at its load strength, before your slider changes
phrases.zh: 渲染出的「基准」：LoRA 在其加载强度下、你更改滑块之前的状态

phrases.en: The Tweaked render as it is now, with your slider changes
phrases.zh: 「调整」渲染的当前状态，包含你的滑块更改

phrases.en: The song repeats - the section when one is set, else the whole song
phrases.zh: 歌曲循环播放——若设置了段落则循环该段落，否则循环整首歌

phrases.en: Each new Tweaked render plays from the top (off: the song carries on at the same moment in its new version)
phrases.zh: 每次新的「调整」渲染都从头播放（关闭：歌曲在新版本中从同一时刻继续）

phrases.en: The whole Tweaked song as rendered (48 kHz WAV)
phrases.zh: 渲染出的完整「调整」歌曲（48 kHz WAV）

phrases.en: The Tweaked song becomes the song to start from, set to Repaint: drag across the waveform to choose a section to make new (the rest stays exactly as it is), or switch Use to Extend.
phrases.zh: 「调整」后的歌曲成为起始歌曲，并设为「重绘」：在波形上拖动以选择要重新生成的段落（其余保持原样），或将 Use 切换为 Extend。

phrases.en: One slider per block of the model. A greyed row is a block the loaded LoRA doesn't train, so moving it changes nothing.
phrases.zh: 模型的每个块对应一个滑块。灰显的行表示已加载 LoRA 不训练该块，因此移动它不会有任何变化。

phrases.en: The main blocks alternate: block 0 on, 1 off, 2 on and so on (even on, odd off); the rest untouched. Invert for the other half. Strengths are kept.
phrases.zh: 主要块交替：块 0 开、1 关、2 开，依此类推（偶数开、奇数关）；其余不变。「反转」用于另一半。强度保持不变。

phrases.en: The detail end of the model (H3: blocks 46-49) all on or all off together. Strengths are kept.
phrases.zh: 模型的细节端（H3：块 46-49）全部一起开或一起关。强度保持不变。

phrases.en: Which LoRA's block strengths a lucky roll changes. Both rolls each one separately.
phrases.zh: 幸运掷骰会更改哪个 LoRA 的块强度。「两者」会分别对每个进行掷骰。

phrases.en: How many sliders a roll changes, picked at random from those not locked or frozen (with Both, a block's primary and donor are two). All: every one.
phrases.zh: 一次掷骰会更改多少个滑块，从那些未锁定或冻结的滑块中随机选取（使用「两者」时，某块的主文件和提供方算作两个）。「全部」：每一个。

phrases.en: Each rolled block's slider is set to a strength between these two
phrases.zh: 每个被掷中的块的滑块会设置为这两个值之间的强度

phrases.en: The lowest slider strength a roll can give (a negative one inverts the block)
phrases.zh: 一次掷骰可给出的最低滑块强度（负值会反转该块）

phrases.en: The highest slider strength a roll can give
phrases.zh: 一次掷骰可给出的最高滑块强度

phrases.en: A lucky roll gives each block it picks a slider strength anywhere in the range set beside it, evenly. Hold keeps this model's structure and tidy-up bands near 1; untick it to roll every block across the whole range.
phrases.zh: 幸运掷骰会为它选中的每个块，在其旁设定的范围内均匀地给出一个滑块强度。Hold 让此模型的结构和整理区间保持在 1 附近；取消勾选则让每个块在整个范围内掷骰。

phrases.en: Lock every block you've moved from its default, so the next rolls leave them alone (and so do presets and the bulk buttons). Press again after a roll to freeze the newly rolled ones too.
phrases.zh: 锁定所有你从默认值移动过的块，让下一次掷骰不再改动它们（预设和批量按钮也不会）。掷骰后再次按下可一并冻结新掷中的块。

phrases.en: Unlock the blocks Freeze locked (blocks you locked yourself stay locked)
phrases.zh: 解锁「冻结」所锁定的块（你自己锁定的块保持锁定）

phrases.en: The sliders a roll can change: not frozen, not locked by you, and on for the LoRA being rolled
phrases.zh: 掷骰可更改的滑块：未冻结、未被你锁定，且对被掷骰的 LoRA 处于开启状态
修复后的 LoRA 文件（.safetensors）

phrases.en: Choosing a LoRA switches to its model.
phrases.zh: 选择 LoRA 会切换到其模型。

phrases.en: with the trigger word, e.g. "zwxem, a portrait photo of a woman"
phrases.zh: 带触发词，例如「zwxem, a portrait photo of a woman」

phrases.en: optional: the same prompt WITHOUT the trigger
phrases.zh: 可选：同一提示词，但不含触发词

phrases.en: Render every epoch of a training run on one seed, then crossfade between them to find the sweet spot.
phrases.zh: 在同一个种子上渲染训练运行的每个轮次，然后在它们之间交叉淡入淡出，以找到最佳轮次。
跟随各检查点自身的模型。

phrases.en: shared by the crossfade, prompt travel and strength travel
phrases.zh: 由交叉淡入淡出、提示词漫游和强度漫游共用

phrases.en: How strongly the reference anchors each epoch render. 1.0 = full edit-model anchor (the reference holds the composition while each epoch's LoRA renders the prompt), lower lets the prompt vary more, 0 = off.
phrases.zh: 参考图对每个轮次渲染的锚定强度。1.0 = 完整编辑模型锚定（参考图保持构图，由每个轮次的 LoRA 渲染提示词），较低值让提示词变化更多，0 = 关闭。

phrases.en: Where clips, stills, sheets and promoted LoRAs go
phrases.zh: 片段、静帧、网格图和「晋级」LoRA 的保存位置

phrases.en: Drag to blend between consecutive epochs - stop where it looks best.
phrases.zh: 拖动以在相邻轮次之间混合——在效果最佳处停下。

phrases.en: how many epochs to render, spread across the run
phrases.zh: 要渲染多少个轮次，均匀分布在整个运行中

phrases.en: Free the GPU: the model leaves the card (the next render loads it again).
phrases.zh: 释放 GPU：模型离开显卡（下次渲染会重新加载）。

phrases.en: Click a thumbnail to jump the crossfade there.
phrases.zh: 点击缩略图可将交叉淡入淡出跳转到该处。

phrases.en: Score likeness first, then export a side-by-side clip: your subject image next to each epoch with its likeness score, morphing epoch by epoch. Uses the Format / Speed / Loop / Fizgig-tag settings below.
phrases.zh: 先评分相似度，再导出并排片段：你的主体图片与每个轮次及其相似度分数并排，逐轮次变形。使用下方的 Format / Speed / Loop / Fizgig-tag 设置。

phrases.en: MP4 is full colour, smaller, faster to write, and autoplays on X / Reddit / Instagram. GIF embeds anywhere but is limited to 256 colours (slight banding on faces), takes longer to export, and makes a larger file.
phrases.zh: MP4 为全彩、体积更小、写入更快，并可在 X / Reddit / Instagram 自动播放。GIF 可嵌入任何地方，但仅限 256 色（面部会有轻微色带），导出更慢，文件也更大。

phrases.en: Save every rendered epoch still as a full-size PNG (named by epoch so they sort in order).
phrases.zh: 将每个渲染出的轮次静帧保存为全尺寸 PNG（按轮次命名以便排序）。

phrases.en: One-click recipes for the mechanics (reference / anchor / journey length / identity lock). They don't touch the prompt - seed travel uses the Setup prompt.
phrases.zh: 针对机制的一键配方（参考图 / 锚定 / 漫游长度 / 身份锁定）。它们不会改动提示词——种子漫游使用「设置」的提示词。

phrases.en: Seeds in the journey. 2 = a straight Start→End morph; more = a tour through extra seeds in between, all slerped. The in-betweens derive from the Start seed, so the journey is reproducible.
phrases.zh: 漫游中的种子数。2 = 直接的 Start→End 变形；更多 = 途经中间额外的种子，全部进行 slerp 插值。中间种子由起始种子派生，因此漫游可复现。

phrases.en: Each frame is a fresh render - more frames = smoother but slower.
phrases.zh: 每一帧都是全新渲染——帧越多越平滑，但越慢。

phrases.en: optional - falls back to the Setup reference
phrases.zh: 可选——缺省时使用「设置」的参考图

phrases.en: Use the rendered epoch as the reference
phrases.zh: 使用渲染出的轮次作为参考图

phrases.en: How strongly the reference holds each frame. Seed travel wants a light anchor, about 0.1-0.4: higher locks every frame to the reference and the travel stops moving.
phrases.zh: 参考图对每帧的约束强度。种子漫游需要较轻的锚定，约 0.1-0.4：较高会让每帧都锁定到参考图，漫游便不再移动。

phrases.en: Feedback chain: frame 1 uses your reference, each later frame edits the previous one. Keep Strength low (about 0.4) with this on - high strength compounds every frame.
phrases.zh: 反馈链：第 1 帧使用你的参考图，之后每帧都编辑前一帧。开启时请将强度保持在较低（约 0.4）——高强度会逐帧累积。

phrases.en: Reference encode resolution cap (megapixels), 0.05-1.0. Higher carries more detail at a little more VRAM.
phrases.zh: 参考图编码分辨率上限（百万像素），0.05-1.0。较高会保留更多细节，但略增显存占用。

phrases.en: Timelapse-style luminance deflicker (post-process). Normal removes frame-to-frame jitter and keeps the intended slow brightness arc; Strong flattens harder.
phrases.zh: 延时摄影式的亮度去闪烁（后处理）。Normal 消除帧间抖动并保留预期的缓慢亮度变化；Strong 则更用力地压平。

phrases.en: Starting points tuned from real runs: each fills the whole card and builds a prompt you can edit. image 1 = your original reference, image 2 = the previous frame.
phrases.zh: 从真实运行中调校出的起点：每个都会填满整张卡片并生成一个可编辑的提示词。image 1 = 你的原始参考图，image 2 = 上一帧。

phrases.en: Type {x} where the travel word goes - no {x}? the word is added at the end.
phrases.zh: 在漫游词的位置输入 {x}——没有 {x}？该词会被加到末尾。

phrases.en: comma-separated - used when the preset is Custom words
phrases.zh: 逗号分隔——当预设为「自定义词」时使用

phrases.en: How strongly the reference holds each frame. Prompt travel wants the full 1.0: the model edits the reference as the prompts ask. Lower lets the frames drift away from it.
phrases.zh: 参考图对每帧的约束强度。提示词漫游需要完整的 1.0：模型按提示词要求编辑参考图。较低值让帧逐渐偏离参考图。

phrases.en: Every frame also references the ORIGINAL image at the Anchor strength alongside the previous frame, so the feedback chain can't drift.
phrases.zh: 每一帧除参考前一帧外，还会以 Anchor 强度参考原始图片，因此反馈链不会漂移。

phrases.en: Linear: the original. Norm-preserved: holds the conditioning strength constant for flatter brightness. Slerp: a constant-speed spherical glide - the smoothest morph.
phrases.zh: Linear：原始方式。Norm-preserved：保持条件强度恒定，亮度更平稳。Slerp：匀速球面滑动——最平滑的变形。

phrases.en: Slerps the noise from the base seed toward a second one across the sweep, so the prompt takes hold (0 = off, 0.1-0.3 gentle, 0.5-1.0 strong). Only with Vary seed off.
phrases.zh: 在整个扫掠过程中，将噪声从基础种子向第二个种子进行 slerp 插值，使提示词更好地生效（0 = 关闭，0.1-0.3 温和，0.5-1.0 强烈）。仅在「变化种子」关闭时有效。

phrases.en: Each frame its own seed (base, base+1, ...) so the prompt expresses more strongly; reproducible. Turns Seed drift off.
phrases.zh: 每帧使用各自的种子（base、base+1、...），使提示词表现更强；可复现。会关闭「种子漂移」。

phrases.en: one per line - each becomes a row
phrases.zh: 每行一个——每个成为一行

phrases.en: ComfyUI reads models/refmods; Fizgig writes new mods to the RefMod model's Output folder on the Training tab - point both at the same place.
phrases.zh: ComfyUI 读取 models/refmods；Fizgig 将新 mod 写入「训练」标签页上 RefMod 模型的输出文件夹——请让两者指向同一位置。

phrases.en: Look for new mods (one you have just made, say)
phrases.zh: 查找新 mod（比如你刚制作的那个）

phrases.en: Which H3 the mods run on. A mod does best on the model it was made for; pick the one you use in ComfyUI.
phrases.zh: mod 运行在哪个 H3 上。mod 在其原生模型上效果最佳；请选择你在 ComfyUI 中使用的那个。

phrases.en: int8 on big cards, streamed blocks for long clips, NF4 for the smallest footprint.
phrases.zh: 大显存显卡用 int8，长片段用流式块，NF4 占用最小。

phrases.en: Free the GPU: the model leaves the card (the next Render loads it again).
phrases.zh: 释放 GPU：模型离开显卡（下次「渲染」会重新加载）。

phrases.en: Reference tokens the model attends to on every step: each mod's T × (H/2) × (W/2), times its copies. The pack caps a mod at 5 120; a bundle well over that slows every step and starves the prompt.
phrases.zh: 模型每一步都关注的参考 token 数：每个 mod 的 T × (H/2) × (W/2)，再乘以其副本数。该 pack 将单个 mod 的上限设为 5 120；远超过此值的 bundle 会拖慢每一步并挤占提示词的 token。

phrases.en: One mod per row; untick a row to leave it out.
phrases.zh: 每行一个 mod；取消勾选某行可将其排除。

phrases.en: A graph preset kept anywhere else: a .png (or .json) the pack's Apply node saved
phrases.zh: 保存在别处的图预设：该 pack 的 Apply 节点保存的 .png（或 .json）文件

phrases.en: Append every active mod's 'concept_type: description' - the Loader node's prompt_hint output
phrases.zh: 追加每个活动 mod 的 'concept_type: description'——即 Loader 节点的 prompt_hint 输出

phrases.en: Each active mod is shown to the text encoder as a numbered picture or video, the way the pack's H3 RefMod Text Encode node does, so the prompt can say 'the woman in <Picture 1>'. Costs a decode per mod.
phrases.zh: 每个活动 mod 都会以编号图片或视频的形式呈现给文本编码器，与该 pack 的 H3 RefMod Text Encode 节点一致，因此提示词可以写 'the woman in <Picture 1>'。每个 mod 需要一次解码。
编号引用（Text Encode 节点）

phrases.en: Turbo LoRA strength: 6 steps at 0.75 is the training-preview regime, 4 at 1.0 the fast dial, 0 = off (20 steps, slow).
phrases.zh: Turbo LoRA 强度：0.75 时 6 步为训练预览模式，1.0 时 4 步为快速模式，0 = 关闭（20 步，较慢）。

phrases.en: Decode the clip's soundtrack (needs the audio VAE in Preferences)
phrases.zh: 解码片段的音轨（需要偏好设置中的音频 VAE）

phrases.en: What the right-hand picture leaves out: the mods (the LoRA alone), the LoRA (the mods alone), or both (the base model).
phrases.zh: 右侧图片排除了什么：mod（仅 LoRA）、LoRA（仅 mod），或两者（基础模型）。

phrases.en: The current setup as a row of short clips with ONE dial stepped through its useful values - the quickest way to see what a control does to this mod.
phrases.zh: 将当前设置渲染为一排短片，其中某个旋钮逐步遍历其有效值——这是最快看清某个控件对该 mod 作用的方式。

phrases.en: (last 12 - click one to put it back on the left)
phrases.zh: （最近 12 个——点击一个可放回左侧）

phrases.en: Where Save preview and Save strip put their files
phrases.zh: 「保存预览」和「保存片段」存放文件的位置
新 mod 名称（保存在源文件旁）
文件名（保存在 LoRA 旁）

phrases.en: The LoRA and the references of the ticked rows, as they are, in one file for ComfyUI's Load H3 RefLoRA node
phrases.zh: 勾选行的 LoRA 及其参考图，原样打包到一个文件中，供 ComfyUI 的 Load H3 RefLoRA 节点使用

phrases.en: Make a LoRA from a LoRA or from a full fine-tune: exact weight SVD, straight from the files - no model loaded.
phrases.zh: 从 LoRA 或完整微调生成 LoRA：直接从文件进行精确权重 SVD——无需加载模型。

phrases.en: A LoRA reduced to a lower rank, or to some of its blocks
phrases.zh: 将 LoRA 降秩，或仅保留其中部分块

（Apply 的 Frame curve——仅视频 mod）视频 mod 的帧沿其长度应用的强度；静态 mod 只有一帧，会忽略此项。
（Step Curve 节点）Off：每一步使用相同强度。concept_at_start 在结构形成阶段保持参考较强，然后在纹理步骤中逐渐减弱。

是这里唯一会写入 mod 的操作：将某一行的 mod 连同其强度、主强度、副本数和淡入淡出折叠在一起，使其以 1.0 强度加载且无曲线（每个文件一个 mod——两个 mod 一起则需两个加载槽）。Shuffle 和步进曲线在渲染时生效，无法烘焙。

phrases.zh: 锁定此块的 donor 滑块（预设、Lucky 和批量操作不会改动它）

phrases.zh: 平衡：另一侧（主 LoRA 或 donor）得到 1 减此值，适用于 0 到 1 之间的值

phrases.zh: （默认先训练标注，再详尽细节）。

phrases.zh: 用上面的模型和任务重新写此文件的标注

phrases.zh: 转写已追加并保存 - 可自由编辑。

phrases.zh: 步数曲线：第一步 → 最后一步

phrases.zh: 没有活动的 mod - 将“带 mods”渲染为纯基础模型。

phrases.zh: 正在渲染带 mods，然后对比…

phrases.zh: 没有活动的 mod 携带描述 - 无可添加。

light sensitivity, migraine: low glare, soft warm greys
phrases.zh: 光敏、偏头痛：低眩光、柔和暖灰

phrases.en: The word Fizgig joins on: the same trigger can join cleanly with one (dlor + woman) and break with another (dlor + man). A style or look is never joined, so only the word itself is checked.
phrases.zh: Fizgig 拼接所依据的词：同一个触发词与某个词拼接可能很干净（dlor + woman），与另一个词则可能断裂（dlor + man）。风格或外观从不参与拼接，因此只检查该词本身。

phrases.en: Optional: the trigger words of your other subjects in this same LoRA, separated by commas. Two subjects whose words start with the same letter, or share a piece, can blend into each other, so the check looks for that too. Leave it empty for a one-subject LoRA.
phrases.zh: 可选：同一 LoRA 中其他主体的触发词，用逗号分隔。首字母相同或共享片段的两个主体可能会相互混淆，因此检查也会关注这一点。单主体 LoRA 留空即可。

phrases.en: For Studio, Royale, the Profiler and Extract. Block swap moves blocks to the CPU between steps to save memory, at some speed. Training manages its own and ignores these.
phrases.zh: 适用于 Studio、Royale、Profiler 和 Extract。块交换会在步骤之间把块移到 CPU 以节省显存，但会损失一定速度。训练自行管理并忽略这些设置。

phrases.en: On by default: same memory as fp8, near-identical pictures, previews only. Turn it off to use fp8.
phrases.zh: 默认开启：显存占用与 fp8 相同，图片几乎一致，仅用于预览。关闭它以使用 fp8。

phrases.en: What Fizgig does on the network without being asked. Pods, RunPod and computers added by their address work either way.
phrases.zh: Fizgig 在网络上未经请求会做的事。Pods、RunPod 和按地址添加的电脑无论开关都能工作。

phrases.en: While the Helpers or Pods tab is open, this computer asks the local network which computers run Fizgig, and it answers theirs (with a web password set). Nothing leaves your network. Off: no asking and no answering.
phrases.zh: 当“辅助”或 Pods 标签页打开时，本机会询问局域网中哪些电脑在运行 Fizgig，并回应它们的询问（需设置网页密码）。所有信息都不会离开你的网络。关闭：既不询问也不应答。

phrases.en: Once at start-up, Fizgig asks GitHub for its newest release tag (the About box says when one is out). Off: no check unless you press Check for updates in the About box.
phrases.zh: 每次启动时，Fizgig 会向 GitHub 查询其最新发布标签（有新版时“关于”框会提示）。关闭：除非你在“关于”框中按“检查更新”，否则不检查。

phrases.en: Windows Firewall doesn't let Fizgig in on this port yet. Allow on my network adds two rules for private networks only: the web UI's port (and the few above it Fizgig moves to when it's taken) and the one other computers find Fizgig on. Windows asks for an administrator's OK.
phrases.zh: Windows 防火墙目前不允许 Fizgig 在此端口通信。“在我的网络上允许”会仅针对专用网络添加两条规则：Web 界面端口（及其被占用时 Fizgig 上移的几个端口）和其他电脑查找 Fizgig 所用的端口。Windows 会请求管理员授权。

phrases.en: Log out everywhere ends every device's login, this one too: a phone left logged in, say. Each one asks for the password again. If someone else knows the password, change it too (Password, above), or they can just log in again.
phrases.zh: 在所有设备退出登录会结束每台设备的登录，包括本机：比如一部仍处于登录状态的手机。每台设备都会再次要求输入密码。如果别人知道密码，也请修改密码（上方的“密码”），否则他们仍可重新登录。

phrases.en: Paused there at the end of its epoch, its new checkpoints, previews and saved state brought here, and it carries on here
phrases.zh: 在那里于 epoch 结束时暂停，其新检查点、预览和已保存状态被带到这里，并在这里继续

phrases.en: Stopped there now and brought back from its last save (the epochs since it are trained again here)
phrases.zh: 立即在那里停止，并从其上次保存处带回（之后的 epoch 会在这里重新训练）

phrases.en: Stopped now and moved from its last save (the epochs since it are trained again there)
phrases.zh: 立即停止并从其上次保存处移走（之后的 epoch 会在那里重新训练）

phrases.en: It pauses here, its saved state and training folder go to the other computer, and it carries on there on the same model files (it downloads any it's missing and makes its own cache). Bring it back from here when you want it.
phrases.zh: 它在这里暂停，其已保存状态和训练文件夹传到另一台电脑，并在那里用相同的模型文件继续（会下载缺失的部分并创建自己的缓存）。需要时从这里把它带回。

phrases.en: Each training image's loss by epoch, and what the loss watch decided about each. To use it, tick one of these on the Training tab before you press Start: Track how each image trains, per-image LR, the look warm-up or auto-recaption.
phrases.zh: 每张训练图片按 epoch 的损失，以及损失观察对每张的判定。要使用它，请在按“开始”前在训练标签页勾选其中一项：跟踪每张图片的训练情况、逐图学习率、外观预热或自动重新标注。

phrases.en: For people. It can tell men from women, for Largest Male / Female Face. It doesn't see anime, furry or drawn faces.
phrases.zh: 适用于真人。可区分男女，用于“最大男性/女性人脸”。它无法识别动漫、兽耳或绘画人脸。

phrases.en: For anime, furry or drawn characters, and fursuits, pick this. It can't tell men from women, so Largest Male / Female Face use the largest face.
phrases.zh: 适用于动漫、兽耳或绘画角色，以及兽装。它无法区分男女，因此“最大男性/女性人脸”会使用最大的人脸。

phrases.en: For a set with both people and characters in it. Both finders look at every picture, so it's a little slower.
phrases.zh: 适用于同时包含真人和角色的数据集。两种查找器都会查看每张图片，因此会稍慢一些。

phrases.en: For people's faces. For anime, furry or drawn characters, pick Anime/furry/drawn.
phrases.zh: 适用于真人人脸。对于动漫、兽耳或绘画角色，请选择 Anime/furry/drawn。

phrases.en: For anime, furry or drawn characters, and fursuits; it works on people too. Its scores run higher than the people setting's, and the colours follow.
phrases.zh: 适用于动漫、兽耳或绘画角色以及兽装；也适用于真人。其分数会比人物设置更高，颜色也随之变化。

phrases.en: Fizgig looks at some of the pictures each time it scores: People (the default) for a set of people, Anime/furry/drawn for anything else.
phrases.zh: Fizgig 每次评分时会查看部分图片：人物数据集用 People（默认），其他用 Anime/furry/drawn。

phrases.en: Qwen3-VL (the Krea 2 text encoder from Preferences) follows an instruction you can edit and writes the best training captions. Florence-2 downloads itself the first time.
phrases.zh: Qwen3-VL（偏好设置中的 Krea 2 文本编码器）会遵循你可编辑的指令，写出最佳的训练标注。Florence-2 首次使用时会自行下载。

phrases.en: Set the Krea 2 text encoder in Preferences to caption with Qwen3-VL, which writes better training captions. Florence-2 downloads itself the first time.
phrases.zh: 请在偏好设置中将 Krea 2 文本编码器设为 Qwen3-VL 来生成标注，它会写出更好的训练标注。Florence-2 首次使用时会自行下载。

phrases.en: It runs on the GPU, a fraction of a second a picture once loaded (several seconds a picture without a GPU). Make masks when nothing is training.
phrases.zh: 它在 GPU 上运行，加载后每张图片只需零点几秒（没有 GPU 时每张图片需数秒）。在没有训练进行时制作蒙版。

phrases.en: It runs on the CPU, a fraction of a second a picture. The first time, it downloads Google's person finder (16 MB).
phrases.zh: 它在 CPU 上运行，每张图片只需零点几秒。首次使用时会下载 Google 的人物查找器（16 MB）。

phrases.en: Making masks needs an update: run update_fizgig to add its one new package (ai-edge-litert).
phrases.zh: 制作蒙版需要更新：运行 update_fizgig 以添加其一个新包（ai-edge-litert）。

phrases.en: Loading the face model and choosing the look match (the first time downloads about 300 MB)…
phrases.zh: 正在加载人脸模型并选择外观匹配（首次会下载约 300 MB）…

phrases.re: ^Fizgig LoRA Isolation joins each subject\'s trigger word to what the subject is: "zwxem, a woman" trains as one word, zwxemwoman\. Some words join badly: the text encoder splits them so the subject word is no longer whole \(fyxo \+ woman reads as f \| yx \| ow \| oman\), and the LoRA learns that subject less cleanly\. This checks a word with (.+)\'s text encoder, the one this LoRA trains with, before you caption\.$
phrases.zh: Fizgig LoRA 隔离会把每个主体的触发词与其身份拼接："zwxem, a woman" 会作为一个词 zwxemwoman 训练。有些词拼接效果很差：文本编码器会把它们拆开，导致主体词不再完整（fyxo + woman 被读作 f | yx | ow | oman），LoRA 对这个主体的学习就不够干净。它会在标注前用 $1 的文本编码器（也就是此 LoRA 训练所用的编码器）来检查一个词。

phrases.en: Klein 9B Base model (for training & precise profiling). Recommended: the fp8 version — same training quality, ~half the VRAM (stays resident at ~9.6GB, fits 16GB cards). The bf16 version is the larger alternative.
phrases.zh: Klein 9B 基础模型（用于训练与精确分析）。推荐 fp8 版本 —— 训练质量相同，显存约省一半（常驻约 9.6GB，适配 16GB 显卡）。bf16 版本是更大的备选。

phrases.zh: Klein 9B 蒸馏模型（用于修复工作室预览、快速分析与诊断）

phrases.zh: Flux 2 自编码器 —— 使用 FLUX.2-dev 根目录的 ae.safetensors（不是 vae/ 子文件夹的 Diffusers 文件）

phrases.zh: ~320MB · 从 FLUX.2-dev 根目录获取 ae.safetensors · 不要用 vae/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors（Diffusers 格式，不兼容）
Qwen3-8B 文本编码器（Klein 9B 使用）

phrases.zh: ~15GB 单文件 safetensors —— 为 Klein 9B 打包的 Qwen3-8B（Comfy-Org）

phrases.zh: 四个模型文件的绝对路径。每行都有一个下载链接，会在浏览器中打开对应的 HuggingFace 页面。

phrases.en: 💡 Training Klein only? The Krea 2 Qwen3-VL text encoder is still worth having — the Captions tab can caption ANY dataset with it, following an instruction you can edit, and it writes better training captions than Florence-2. The download button below fetches it for you; nothing else about Krea 2 is needed.
phrases.zh: 💡 只训练 Klein？Krea 2 的 Qwen3-VL 文本编码器仍然值得拥有 —— “标注”标签页可以用它为任意数据集写标注，遵循你可编辑的指令，写出的训练标注比 Florence-2 更好。下方的下载按钮会帮你获取；Krea 2 的其他东西都不需要。

phrases.en: Fetches the four files above plus the Krea 2 Qwen3-VL captioning text encoder (~39 GB all in) and fills in these paths for you, plus the small helper models (Florence-2 captioner, face model for the Look Filter and likeness scoring, EN→ZH translator, Gizmo's Whisper transcriber — ~1.9 GB) so nothing stalls to download later and everything works offline. Black Forest Labs gate their downloads, so you'll need a free HuggingFace token — Fizgig asks for it and tells you which pages to accept the licence on.
phrases.zh: 获取上述四个文件以及 Krea 2 的 Qwen3-VL 标注文本编码器（合计约 39 GB）并为你填好这些路径；还包括小型辅助模型（Florence-2 标注器、用于 Look Filter 与相似度评分的人脸模型、英→中翻译器、Gizmo 的 Whisper 转写器 —— 约 1.9 GB），之后不会再卡在下载上，一切可离线使用。Black Forest Labs 的下载需要许可，因此你需要一个免费的 HuggingFace token —— Fizgig 会向你索取，并告诉你需要在哪些页面接受许可。

phrases.en: Block ids follow the old Repair Studio (double_0-7, single_0-23), so its saved presets apply.
phrases.zh: 块 id 沿用旧版修复工作室（double_0-7、single_0-23），其保存的预设仍然适用。
按文件原样（bf16 或 fp8）

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) picks at launch: INT8 compiled when torch.compile can run and the run is long enough (the fastest Klein setup), otherwise your Base file as it is - BFL's fp8 file trains in fp8, as Klein always has. Too little free VRAM for those: 4-bit NF4. "As the file" never requantises; INT8 and NF4 requantise from the file.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）在启动时选择：当 torch.compile 可运行且训练足够长时用 INT8 编译（最快的 Klein 配置），否则按你的基础文件原样使用 —— BFL 的 fp8 文件以 fp8 训练，正如 Klein 一贯的方式。空闲显存太少时：4-bit NF4。“按文件原样”从不重新量化；INT8 和 NF4 会从文件重新量化。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) turns torch.compile on only when this run is long enough to repay it. On Klein 9B it is measured 2.1x per step on the INT8 base (1.14 -> 0.54 s/step) with LESS memory than uncompiled (the gradient checkpoint stays outside the compiled blocks), and 1.4x on NF4. The first epoch runs slower while the blocks compile, so Auto waits for runs longer than about 200 steps on INT8 and 400 on NF4, and checks the compiled run fits your free VRAM. The fp8 base is not compiled by Auto (1.1x; On still compiles). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) - both located automatically. Never used with Blocks Swap, since swapping moves weights and compiled graphs assume they stay put.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）仅在本轮训练长到能回本时才开启 torch.compile。在 Klein 9B 上实测：INT8 基座每步加速 2.1 倍（1.14 -> 0.54 秒/步），显存反而比不编译更少（梯度检查点在编译块之外），NF4 上为 1.4 倍。第一个 epoch 因块编译而较慢，所以自动模式会等训练超过约 200 步（INT8）或 400 步（NF4）再编译，并检查编译后的运行适合你的空闲显存。fp8 基座不会被自动编译（1.1 倍；手动开启仍会编译）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。从不与块交换同时使用，因为交换会移动权重，而编译图假定它们不动。

phrases.en: Guidance-distilled: no CFG; ComfyUI's Euler simple schedule at shift 2.02.
phrases.zh: 引导蒸馏：无 CFG；ComfyUI 的 Euler simple 调度，shift 2.02。

phrases.en: Use Distilled model for samples (4-step, matches ComfyUI)
phrases.zh: 样本使用蒸馏模型（4 步，与 ComfyUI 一致）

phrases.en: Base samples only — Distilled is locked at 4 steps
phrases.zh: 仅基础模型样本 —— 蒸馏模型锁定为 4 步

phrases.en: Pairs of an original and its edited version, the same crop and shape - about 40 pairs is a good start (20 at least). Each photo 1 MP or larger; Fizgig resizes them.
phrases.zh: 一对原图及其编辑版本，相同的裁剪和形状 —— 约 40 对是不错的起点（至少 20 对）。每张照片 1 百万像素或更大；Fizgig 会自动调整。

phrases.en: Base has no guidance embed: only CFG steers it, and CFG 1 ignores the negative prompt. Empirical-mu schedule.
phrases.zh: 基础模型没有引导嵌入：只有 CFG 引导它，CFG 1 会忽略负面提示词。Empirical-mu 调度。

phrases.en: Base has no guidance embed, so CFG is the only guidance: 1 = none (the negative prompt is ignored); about 3.5 to 4.5 gives guided previews.
phrases.zh: 基础模型没有引导嵌入，CFG 是唯一的引导：1 = 无（忽略负面提示词）；约 3.5 到 4.5 可产生带引导的预览。

phrases.en: ✨ Old Reliable (rank 16, full model, single subject)
phrases.zh: ✨ 老当益壮（rank 16，完整模型，单主体）

phrases.en: ✨ Old Reliable - Flavour 8 (rank 8, full model, single subject)
phrases.zh: ✨ 老当益壮 - Flavour 8（rank 8，完整模型，单主体）
✨ 多角色（rank 16，多角色或多概念）
自动（适配你的空闲显存）

phrases.en: Timesteps: flux2_shift - logit-normal, shift exp(mu) with mu 0.5 at 256 latent tokens to 1.15 at 4096, unweighted MSE on the flow-matching velocity.
phrases.zh: 时间步：flux2_shift —— logit-normal，shift exp(mu)，mu 在 256 个潜 token 时为 0.5、4096 时为 1.15，对流匹配速度做无加权 MSE。

phrases.en: Where the LoRA, its checkpoints and the previews go. A folder picked here is kept for this model; empty (or Reset to default) uses the LoRA output folder in Preferences.
phrases.zh: LoRA、其检查点和预览的存放位置。此处选择的文件夹会为此模型保留；留空（或“恢复默认”）则使用偏好设置中的 LoRA 输出文件夹。

phrases.en: These settings are read when a run starts. A paused run resumes with its own settings (only a new picture size is offered); a dataset or caption change needs a fresh run. The previews' prompts can change while it trains, on the Samples tab.
phrases.zh: 这些设置在训练开始时读取。暂停的运行以其自身设置恢复（仅可改新的图片尺寸）；数据集或标注变化需要新一轮训练。预览的提示词可以在训练期间在“样本”标签页修改。

phrases.en:
Off: only the pictures directly in the training folder are used.
On: the pictures in its sub-folders are trained on too, at any depth, each sub-folder as its own set with its own captions and cache, so a big dataset can stay organised. Every picture trains once an epoch, wherever it is. Image Prep and Captions work on one folder at a time: to caption or mask a sub-folder, choose it as the training folder on the Start tab.
phrases.zh:
关闭：仅使用训练文件夹中直接的图片。
开启：其子文件夹中的图片也参与训练，不限深度，每个子文件夹作为独立数据集、有自己的标注和缓存，大数据集也能保持整洁。每张图片每个 epoch 训练一次，无论在哪。图像预处理和标注一次只处理一个文件夹：要标注或加蒙版某个子文件夹，请在“开始”标签页把它选为训练文件夹。

phrases.en: When on, the Learning Rate box is ignored: the run starts at the geometric midpoint of Min and Max and the watcher sets the rate from there.
phrases.zh: 开启时忽略学习率框：运行从最小值和最大值的几何中点开始，由观察器从那里设定速率。

phrases.en: Which blocks train. Style also limits training to the late, clean timesteps. Custom picks the blocks yourself.
phrases.zh: 哪些块参与训练。风格还会把训练限制在后期较干净的时间步。自定义则由你自己选块。

phrases.en: 0-1000: 0 is the clean end, 1000 pure noise. Empty = the whole range.
phrases.zh: 0-1000：0 是干净端，1000 是纯噪声。留空 = 整个范围。

phrases.en: Ticked: every N epochs up to that epoch, then the second rate (whole multiples). Every 5, then from epoch 10 every 1, saves epochs 5, 10, 11, 12, 13 and on. The last epoch is always saved.
phrases.zh: 勾选：每 N 个 epoch 直到该 epoch，之后用第二个速率（整数倍）。先每 5，然后从 epoch 10 起每 1，会保存 epoch 5、10、11、12、13 及以后。最后一个 epoch 总是会保存。

phrases.en: Trains with an existing LoRA active on the base. Use the same LoRA and strength at inference.
phrases.zh: 训练时在基座上激活一个现有 LoRA。推理时使用相同的 LoRA 和强度。

phrases.en: Images are resized to this area, any aspect ratio: 0.25 = 496 x 496, 1.0 = 992 x 992, 1.05 = 1024 x 1024, 2.4 = 1536 x 1536, 4.2 = 2048 x 2048. 4.2 MP wants 24-32 GB.
LoKR: potentially higher quality · LoRA: ~20% faster training
phrases.zh: LoKR：质量可能更高 · LoRA：训练快约 20%

phrases.en: 8 is the sweet spot · 4 = four times the parameters: stronger, a bigger file, and ~5 GB more VRAM with adamw (use adamw8bit) · above 8: just use LoRA
phrases.zh: 8 是最佳值 · 4 = 四倍参数：更强、文件更大，用 adamw 时多占约 5 GB 显存（可用 adamw8bit）· 8 以上：直接用 LoRA

phrases.en: Used by Auto-recaption (below): it adds this word at the end of a new caption. The training folder's word, the same as the Captions tab's.
phrases.zh: 由自动重新标注（下方）使用：它把这个词加到新标注末尾。即训练文件夹的词，与“标注”标签页的相同。

phrases.en: Saves and previews a running average of the LoRA instead of its latest step: smoother, less overbaked. 0.98 averages over roughly the last 50 steps.
phrases.zh: 保存并预览 LoRA 的滑动平均而非最新一步：更平滑、不易过火。0.98 大致对最近 50 步取平均。

phrases.en: Track how each image trains (per-image loss)
phrases.zh: 跟踪每张图片的训练（逐图损失）

phrases.en: Follows every image's loss through the run. Most images do their work early and are simply learned by the end, which is what you want; a few stay hard, often because the caption doesn't match the picture. Each image's progress, with its thumbnail and its caption to edit, is under Per-image loss on the run card while it trains, and in Runs & outputs.
phrases.zh: 跟随每张图片在整个运行中的损失。多数图片早期出力、到结束时已被简单学会，这正是你想要的；少数一直很难，常因标注与图片不符。每张图的进度（含缩略图和可编辑标注）在训练期间位于运行卡片的“逐图损失”下，也在“运行与输出”里。

phrases.en: Per-image adaptive LR (throttle stuck images, boost healthy learned ones)
phrases.zh: 逐图自适应学习率（给卡住的图片降速，给学好的图片加成）

phrases.en: Images that stay hard without improving train more gently (x0.7, then x0.5 down to x0.1); mined-out ones ease off (x0.6) and healthy learned ones get a gentle boost (x1.1). Batch size 1.
phrases.zh: 一直困难且无改善的图片训练得更温和（x0.7，再 x0.5 降到 x0.1）；已榨干的图片放缓（x0.6），学得健康的图片获得轻微加成（x1.1）。批次大小为 1。

phrases.en: Warm up look outliers (unusual angles ease in at low LR - needs a Look Filter scan)
phrases.zh: 外观离群图预热（不常见角度以低学习率缓入 —— 需要 Look Filter 扫描）

phrases.en: Images the Image Prep Look Filter scored as look outliers (tight angles, profiles - real but unusual) start at x0.4 and ramp to x1.0 over the first ~4 epochs, so they refine the identity instead of fighting it while it forms. Run the Look Filter (with 3 baselines) on this folder first: it saves the scores with the dataset. Without them this does nothing.
phrases.zh: 被图像预处理 Look Filter 判为外观离群的图片（刁钻角度、侧面 —— 真实但不常见）从 x0.4 起步、在头 ~4 个 epoch 内升至 x1.0，让它们在身份成形期间去润色而非对抗它。请先对该文件夹运行 Look Filter（带 3 个基线）：分数会随数据集保存。没有分数则此功能无效。

phrases.en: Auto-recaption stuck images (Qwen3-VL rewrites the caption between epochs)
phrases.zh: 自动重标卡住的图片（Qwen3-VL 在 epoch 之间重写标注）

phrases.en: A stuck image gets a new caption written from what is in it, and a fresh start; a second try goes into more detail. Still stuck after that, it is left out of training - edit its caption to bring it back. Needs the Krea 2 text encoder set in Preferences.
phrases.zh: 卡住的图片会根据其内容获得一条新标注并重新开始；第二次尝试会更详细。之后仍卡住的会被排除出训练 —— 编辑其标注可将其带回。需要在偏好设置中配置 Krea 2 文本编码器。

phrases.en: The Captions tab's instruction for that task, as you've edited it there. The defaults are written for a person (viewpoint, whether the face shows): for a style or a concept, set both tries to suit your LoRA, e.g. Style, or Custom with your own instruction.
phrases.zh: 该任务使用“标注”标签页的指令（按你在那里的编辑）。默认指令为人物编写（视角、露脸与否）：风格或概念 LoRA 请把两次尝试都设为合适的，如“风格”，或“自定义”填你自己的指令。

phrases.en: Style — contents only (trigger word names the style)
phrases.zh: 风格 —— 仅内容（触发词命名风格）

phrases.en: Used when the first new caption didn't help. Set separately from the first try.
phrases.zh: 在第一条新标注无济于事时使用。与第一次尝试分开设置。

phrases.en: The photo only: an edit that changes how a photo looks (a grade, a relight, a retouch). The photo + extra pictures: an edit that brings something from other pictures into it (a person, an object, a place).
phrases.zh: 仅照片：改变照片观感的编辑（调色、重打光、修图）。照片 + 附加图片：把其他图片中的内容带入的编辑（人物、物品、场景）。

phrases.en: Your original, unedited photos. No captions needed.
phrases.zh: 你的原始未编辑照片。无需标注。

phrases.en:
The pictures to bring into the edits: a person, an object, a place.
Name each after the photo it belongs to, adding _1, _2 ...: for beach.jpg, its extras are beach_1.jpg, beach_2.jpg.
The number is the order the model sees them in: beach_1 is the second picture after the original, beach_2 the third. Say so in the edit instruction, e.g. "Put the man from the second picture into this scene."
A photo can have none (it trains as a normal pair) or up to 3. Any shape or file type.
phrases.zh:
要带入编辑的图片：人物、物品、场景。
每张以所属照片命名并加 _1、_2 …：如 beach.jpg 的附加图是 beach_1.jpg、beach_2.jpg。
编号是模型看到它们的顺序：beach_1 是原图后的第二张，beach_2 是第三张。在编辑指令中说明这一点，例如“把第二张图里的男人放进这个场景。”
一张照片可以没有（按普通对训练）或最多 3 张。任意形状和文件类型。

phrases.en: The same photos after your edit, with the same file names as the originals. It is the training folder on the Start tab: choosing it here changes it there too.
phrases.zh: 编辑后的同一批照片，文件名与原图相同。它就是“开始”标签页的训练文件夹：在这里选择会同步改变那里。

phrases.en: What the edit is, e.g. "Apply my concert grade." Write captions saves it as the caption of every photo in the Edited folder.
phrases.zh: 编辑的内容，如“应用我的音乐会调色。”写入标注会把它存为已编辑文件夹中每张照片的标注。

phrases.en:
Optional - you can leave this empty. A photo for the previews to edit, so you can watch the LoRA learn: an original, unedited photo that is in neither folder. One it never trains on shows whether it learned the edit itself. Any size.
Left empty, the previews use your first original - that works, but it is a photo the LoRA trains on, so the previews can look better than the LoRA really is.
With extra pictures: put the test photo's own in the Extra pictures folder the same way (test_1.jpg, test_2.jpg ... for test.jpg).
phrases.zh:
可选 —— 可以留空。一张供预览编辑的照片，用来观察 LoRA 的学习：既不在两个文件夹中的原始未编辑照片。一张它从未训练过的照片能看出它是否学会了编辑本身。任意尺寸。
留空时预览使用你的第一张原图 —— 也可行，但它是 LoRA 训练过的照片，预览可能比 LoRA 实际更好。
有附加图片时：测试照片自己的附加图同样放进附加图片文件夹（test.jpg 对应 test_1.jpg、test_2.jpg …）。

phrases.en: Photos showing the +1 end of the dial (e.g. the person smiling). The captions go in this folder (step 3). It is the training folder on the Start tab: choosing it here changes it there too.
phrases.zh: 展示滑杆 +1 端的照片（如人物微笑）。标注放在此文件夹（第 3 步）。它就是“开始”标签页的训练文件夹：在这里选择会同步改变那里。

phrases.en: The same shots showing the -1 end (e.g. not smiling), each with the same file name as its +1 photo. No captions in this folder.
phrases.zh: 展示 -1 端的相同照片（如不微笑），文件名与 +1 照片相同。此文件夹中不放标注。

phrases.en: Describe what the two photos of a pair have in common, and leave out the difference. For a smile dial, where each +1 photo shows someone smiling and its -1 photo the same person not smiling, the caption is "a portrait photo of a person" - not "a smiling person", because the smile is the difference the dial learns from the photos. For a dial about something else, describe the subject the same way, e.g. "a photo of a room" for a lighting dial. Write captions saves the same line as the caption of every photo in the training (+1) folder, so keep it general enough to fit every pair.
phrases.zh: 描述一对两张照片的共同点，略去差异。以微笑滑杆为例：每张 +1 照片是某人微笑、其 -1 照片是同一人不微笑，标注应为“一个人的肖像照” —— 而非“一个微笑的人”，因为微笑正是滑杆要从照片学出的差异。其他主题的滑杆同样描述主体即可，如灯光滑杆用“一个房间的照片”。写入标注会把同一行存为训练（+1）文件夹每张照片的标注，所以要写得足够泛、能覆盖每一对。

phrases.en: How hard the ends are pushed apart. Higher gives a stronger dial but changes more than the one thing you asked for (a frown can turn into a different, older man). Start on 2. You can change the prompts and this while it trains, on the Run card.
phrases.zh: 两端被推开的力度。更高滑杆更强，但改变的不止你要求的那一件事（皱眉可能变成另一个更老的人）。从 2 开始。训练期间可以在运行卡片上修改提示词和此项。

phrases.en: Prompts the dial must not change, one a line. For a hair-length dial meant for women, "a photo of a man" keeps men's hair as it is; for a smile dial, "a photo of a dog" keeps it to people. Each step checks one of them in turn, and the previews show the first one beside the dial, so you can see it stay put. Each one makes a step about half as long again. Empty = none.
phrases.zh: 滑杆不得改变的提示词，一行一条。以面向女性的发长滑杆为例，“一个男人的照片”让男性发型保持原样；以微笑滑杆为例，“一只狗的照片”把它限定在人。每步轮流检查其中一条，预览会把第一条显示在滑杆旁，你可以看到它纹丝不动。每条会让一步长约增加一半。留空 = 无。

phrases.en: How much keeping them as they are counts against the dial itself. 1 is equal weight; higher holds them tighter but can weaken the dial; lower lets a little of the change through.
phrases.zh: 保持原样的权重与滑杆本身的对抗程度。1 为等权；更高则持得更紧但可能削弱滑杆；更低会漏进一点变化。

phrases.en: Photo pairs: two folders of the same shots, one for each end of the dial (e.g. the same person smiling, and not smiling). 4 to 10 pairs, each pair framed the same. For a dial about people, use a different person in each pair if you can: the dial then learns only the change, and works on anyone. A dial about something else (lighting, colour, a scene) works the same way: the same subject at both ends of a pair, and a different one in each pair.
phrases.zh: 照片对：两个文件夹放相同照片、各对应滑杆一端（如同一人微笑与不微笑）。4 到 10 对，每对取景相同。人物滑杆尽量每对用不同的人：滑杆便只学变化、对任何人都有效。其他主题（灯光、色彩、场景）同理：一对两端同一主体，每对换一个主体。

phrases.en: Prompts: no photos - you describe the picture and what each end adds, and Fizgig renders its own practice pictures from the description and trains on them. The practice pictures are the size Target Megapixels sets (0.5 = 704 x 704). The previews are strips of three pictures on one seed, at -1, 0 and +1.
phrases.zh: 提示词：无照片 —— 你描述画面及每端增加的内容，Fizgig 按描述自绘练习图并训练。练习图尺寸由目标百万像素设定（0.5 = 704 x 704）。预览是同一种子上 -1、0、+1 三张图的条带。

phrases.en: Each rotation trains every part of the model once.
phrases.zh: 每轮轮换把模型的每个部分训练一次。
每 N 轮保存检查点 + 预览

phrases.en: Epochs per part before the next
phrases.zh: 每部分训练多少 epoch 再换下一个

phrases.en: How many parts train together. Auto packs as many as your card holds - the whole model at once when it fits, so nothing rotates. A smaller cap means more windows and more memory to spare, if Auto runs too close to your card's limit.
phrases.zh: 多少部分一起训练。自动会尽量多打包 —— 显存够时整个模型一次训练，无轮换。上限更小意味着更多窗口和更多富余显存，当“自动”太接近显卡上限时用。

phrases.en: Auto - as few windows as fit

phrases.zh: 每窗口一部分（最大余量）

phrases.en: Free each gradient as soon as it's used (less memory - recommended)
phrases.zh: 梯度用完即释放（省显存 - 推荐）

phrases.en: A folder of ordinary photos of the broader class (men, women, people) with normal detailed captions. They hold the model's sense of that class in place while your images train - a full fine-tune moves every weight, so nothing else bounds that drift. Use real photos, not model output: generated images anchor the model to its own artifacts. Leave empty to train without one.
phrases.zh: 一个放更宽泛类别（男人、女人、人物）普通照片的文件夹，配正常详细标注。它们在你自己的图片训练时稳住模型对该类别的认知 —— 全量微调会动每个权重，没有别的能约束这种漂移。用真实照片而非模型生成图：生成图会把模型锚定在自身瑕疵上。留空则不使用。

phrases.en: The regularisation photos train at this fraction of the LR: 0.1-0.3 keeps them a light anchor; at 1.0 they are a second subject set.
phrases.zh: 正则化照片以学习率的这个比例训练：0.1-0.3 让它们是轻锚点；1.0 时它们就是第二组主体。

phrases.en: To share a fine-tune as ordinary LoRAs (several ranks at once), use Extract > From a fine-tune with the checkpoint it saves.
phrases.zh: 要把微调分享为普通 LoRA（多个 rank 一次导出），请用“提取 > 从微调”配合它保存的检查点。

phrases.en: Auto plans the fewest swapped blocks that fit your free VRAM.
phrases.zh: 自动规划适配你空闲显存的最少交换块数。

phrases.en: Empty for a normal run. The easy way to carry a run on is Continue on Runs & outputs: from its newest save, with its own settings (a run that trained all its epochs asks how far to go). Here, a state folder (myLora-000012-state) continues that run with the settings on this tab, so keep them as the run had them - its Optimizer Type especially - and raise Max Train Epochs to train a finished LoRA further, or it ends at once.
phrases.zh: 普通训练留空。继续训练最简单的方式是“运行与输出”里的“继续”：从最新保存、用其自身设置（训满全部 epoch 的运行会询问要训到哪）。此处填状态文件夹（myLora-000012-state）则以本标签页的设置继续该运行，所以请保持与原运行相同 —— 尤其是优化器类型 —— 并调大最大训练 epoch 以继续训练已完成的 LoRA，否则它会立即结束。

phrases.en: Save state at the end of training

phrases.zh: 保留最近 N 个状态

phrases.en: States are big (a LoRA plus its optimizer).
phrases.zh: 状态文件很大（一个 LoRA 加上其优化器）。

phrases.en: Every model trains one image at a time. For a larger effective batch, raise this: the same averaged gradient as a bigger batch, at the memory of batch 1.
phrases.zh: 每个模型一次只训练一张图。要更大的有效批次请调高此项：与更大批次相同的平均梯度，但只用批次 1 的显存。

phrases.en: No Upscale (keep small images at native size)
phrases.zh: 不放大（小图保持原始尺寸）

phrases.en: Blank uses the captions' trigger word.
phrases.zh: 留空使用标注的触发词。

phrases.en: Blank embeds the latest preview; type off for none.
phrases.zh: 留空嵌入最新预览；输入 off 则不嵌入。

phrases.en: Train on the parts your masks show
phrases.zh: 只训练蒙版显示的部分

phrases.en:
For pictures where only part of the frame matters - the person, not the room around them.

Save a black-and-white mask beside a picture, named after it with -masklabel added: photo.jpg -> photo-masklabel.png. White is trained fully, grey partly, black only as much as the setting below. The picture itself still trains whole.

Pictures without a mask train as normal. Masks made in OneTrainer work as they are.
phrases.zh:
适用于画面中只有部分重要的图片 —— 人，而非其周围的房间。

在图片旁保存一张黑白蒙版，以图片命名并加 -masklabel 后缀：photo.jpg -> photo-masklabel.png。白色全量训练，灰色部分训练，黑色仅按下方设置的程度。图片本身仍整体参与训练。

无蒙版的图片正常训练。OneTrainer 制作的蒙版可直接使用。

phrases.en: How much outside the mask counts
0.1 keeps a little of the background, so the LoRA still knows your subject sits in a scene. 0 ignores it completely - then a very small mask trains hard on a few spots.
phrases.zh: 0.1 保留一点背景，让 LoRA 仍知道主体处于场景中。0 完全忽略 —— 很小的蒙版会在少数点位上猛烈训练。

phrases.en: Outside the mask, keep the model's own picture (prior preservation)
phrases.zh: 蒙版外保持模型自身的画面（先验保留）

phrases.en:
Off: outside the mask the LoRA still learns a little of your photos (as much as How much outside the mask counts says).
0.5, 1 or 2: outside the mask it learns to draw what the model itself would, so backgrounds and the model's look stay its own. The higher the number, the firmer.
Speed: each step takes up to about half as long again.
phrases.zh:
关闭：蒙版外 LoRA 仍会学一点你的照片（程度即“蒙版外的参与程度”所述）。
0.5、1 或 2：蒙版外学习绘制模型本身会画的内容，背景和模型风格保持原样。数字越大越牢固。
速度：每步最多多花约一半时间。

phrases.en: With 1 subject and Off, this is ordinary LoRA training. The other choices keep your subjects apart from everyone else, using Fizgig's own techniques together with DOP (Differential Output Preservation) from @ostris's AI-Toolkit.
phrases.zh: 单主体 + 关闭即普通 LoRA 训练。其余选项让你的主体与其他人分开，采用 Fizgig 自有技术配合 @ostris 的 AI-Toolkit 的 DOP（差分输出保留）。
这个 LoRA 是关于谁的？

phrases.en:
Each subject is a folder of their photos, with their own trigger word in every caption - that is how the LoRA tells them apart. Caption each folder first.
Up to 4 people work well, with 2 or 3 of them in one picture. With a person the model already knows well in the picture too: 2 subjects is reliable, 3 is hit and miss.
phrases.zh:
每个主体是一个放其照片的文件夹，每条标注含其专属触发词 —— LoRA 以此区分他们。请先为每个文件夹写标注。
最多 4 人效果良好，其中 2-3 人可同框。若同框的还有模型熟知的人：2 个主体可靠，3 个时好时坏。

phrases.en: The training folder - change it on the Start tab.
phrases.zh: 训练文件夹 —— 在“开始”标签页修改。

phrases.en:
What each subject is decides what Fizgig adds to its training.
From its captions: Fizgig decides - a person if the captions say woman, man, girl or boy, otherwise an animal or thing.
A person: also trains on side-by-side pictures next to strangers, so other people keep their own faces.
An animal or thing: a dog, a cat, a car. Its word is joined like a person's (rexodog), with no side-by-side pictures.
A style or look: paper cut, a lighting style. Its trigger word stays as written, and the look only appears when you use it.
phrases.zh:
每个主体是什么决定 Fizgig 为其训练增加什么。
从标注判断：Fizgig 自行决定 —— 标注写了 woman、man、girl 或 boy 则视为人，否则视为动物或物。
人：还会与陌生人同框的并排图一起训练，让其他人保持自己的脸。
动物或物：狗、猫、车。其词与人一样拼接（rexodog），无并排图。
风格或外观：剪纸、打光风格。其触发词保持原样，外观只在你使用时出现。

phrases.en:
Off: your subject's face can leak onto other people, even in prompts that don't use its trigger word.
Leave the rest of the model alone: ask for "a man at a party" without the trigger word and you get a stranger, just as the model made before you trained. Your subject only appears when you call for them. With one person, use it when your subject must stay out of prompts without the trigger word; otherwise use Off.
Fizgig LoRA Isolation: your subjects can stand together in one picture, or next to a person the model already knows well, and every face stays right. Best for people, and needs two or more subjects in the LoRA. Training takes about 1.5x as long. Prompt with the word shown at the bottom of this card for each subject, e.g. zwxemwoman.
phrases.zh:
关闭：你主体的脸可能渗到其他人身上，即使提示词没用它的触发词。
其余保持原样：不带触发词请求“派对上的一个男人”，得到的是训练前模型就会给的陌生人。你的主体只在你点名时出现。单人时，当主体必须不出现在无触发词的提示词里就用它；否则用关闭。
Fizgig LoRA 隔离：你的主体们可以同框、或与模型熟知的人同框，每张脸都保持正确。最适合人物，且需要 LoRA 含两个及以上主体。训练耗时约 1.5 倍。提示时对每个主体使用本卡片底部显示的词，如 zwxemwoman。

phrases.en: Use my captions exactly as written
phrases.zh: 完全按我写的标注使用

phrases.en: No joining or guessing: Fizgig trains on your captions as they are. Write each subject's joined word (zwxemwoman) into the captions yourself. The side-by-side pictures and the training recipe stay on.
phrases.zh: 不拼接不猜测：Fizgig 按你的原样训练。请自己把每个主体的拼接词（zwxemwoman）写进标注。并排图和训练配方保持开启。
并排图片：优先用人脸裁剪

phrases.en: The 16 pictures of your subject beside a stranger use Image Prep's face crops (FaceCrop_ files) first, then photos where a face is found. Untick to pick from every photo, e.g. for more body shape. A face crop is never cropped further; other photos are framed on the face, never zoomed.
phrases.zh: 主体与陌生人同框的 16 张图优先用图像预处理的人脸裁剪（FaceCrop_ 文件），其次用找到人脸的照片。取消勾选则从所有照片挑选，比如要更多体型。人脸裁剪不会被再裁；其他照片以人脸取景、绝不放大。

phrases.en: Correct a trigger word, or what a subject is
phrases.zh: 修正触发词或主体的类别

phrases.en: Fizgig reads each subject's trigger word, and what they are, from their captions. Tick this only if the line under a subject shows the wrong word.
phrases.zh: Fizgig 从标注读取每个主体的触发词及其类别。仅当主体下方那行显示的词有误时才勾选。

phrases.en: Repeats the smaller folders so each subject gets about as many steps an epoch as the largest. Epochs get longer by the repeats.
phrases.zh: 重复较小的文件夹，使每个主体每 epoch 的步数与最大者大致相同。epoch 会因重复而变长。

phrases.en:
The word your captions use for this subject, e.g. zwxem.
The box shows the word Fizgig found. Type over it only if that is wrong.
phrases.zh:
你的标注对该主体使用的词，如 zwxem。
输入框显示 Fizgig 找到的词。仅当有误时才改写。

phrases.en:
One word: woman, man, girl, boy, dog, cat ...
The box shows what Fizgig found. Type over it only if that is wrong.
phrases.zh:
一个词：woman、man、girl、boy、dog、cat …
输入框显示 Fizgig 找到的结果。仅当有误时才改写。
主体 1 - 训练将使用的词
主体 2 - 训练将使用的词
主体 3 - 训练将使用的词
主体 4 - 训练将使用的词

phrases.en: How to set up Fizgig LoRA Isolation
phrases.zh: 如何设置 Fizgig LoRA 隔离

phrases.en: A step-by-step video of this card · Watch on YouTube
phrases.zh: 本卡片的分步视频 · 在 YouTube 上观看

phrases.en: Edit LoRA previews: each round makes one picture from your edit instruction and test photo (Training tab, Edit pairs, with its extra pictures). The prompts below are not used - to try other instructions while it trains, type them below (one per line) and tick Change the previews of the run going now.
phrases.zh: 编辑 LoRA 预览：每轮按你的编辑指令和测试照片生成一张图（训练标签页的“编辑对”，含附加图片）。下方提示词不使用 —— 训练期间想试其他指令，在下方输入（一行一条）并勾选“更改当前运行的预览”。

phrases.en: One prompt per line: Enter starts the next. The numbers are the gallery's Prompt 1, 2, 3…
phrases.zh: 一行一条提示词：回车开始下一行。编号即图库的提示词 1、2、3…

phrases.en: Tip - catch overtraining early: give one prompt something your dataset doesn't have, a pose, angle or setting none of your photos show. Early epochs follow it. When the LoRA starts to overtrain, that's the first thing to fail, as the previews drift back to your photos. The last epoch that still follows it is a good one to keep.
phrases.zh: 小贴士 - 尽早发现过训：给某条提示词加上数据集里没有的东西 —— 一个所有照片都没出现的姿势、角度或场景。早期 epoch 会跟随它。当 LoRA 开始过训时它最先失效，预览会漂回你的照片。仍跟随它的最后一个 epoch 是值得保留的。

phrases.en: Change the previews of the run going now

On by default. While it's ticked, a change you make here (prompts, seed, size, steps, CFG, Turbo strength) goes to the run training now, from its next preview; new prompts are encoded again then. Untick to put the run back on its own.
phrases.zh: 默认开启。勾选期间，你在此的修改（提示词、种子、尺寸、步数、CFG、Turbo 强度）从下一个预览起作用于当前训练的运行；新提示词届时重新编码。取消勾选则让运行回到自己的轨道。

phrases.en: Optional - every preview edits this photo with its prompt, at the photo's shape. Leave empty for normal previews. An Edit LoRA run previews on the photo set on its own card instead.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— 每张预览都按其提示词编辑这张照片，用照片的形状。留空则正常预览。编辑 LoRA 运行的预览改用它自己卡片上设置的照片。

phrases.en: Ticked: every N epochs up to that epoch, then the second rate (whole multiples). Every 5, then from epoch 10 every 1, previews epochs 5, 10, 11, 12, 13 and on.
phrases.zh: 勾选：每 N 个 epoch 直到该 epoch，之后用第二个间隔（整数倍）。先每 5，然后从 epoch 10 起每 1，预览 epoch 5、10、11、12、13 及以后。
样本模型缓存在内存中

phrases.en: The start of the prompt. Each end's words are added after it with a space, so end this line with a comma if you want one. One person: describe them, e.g. "a close-up photo of a young woman with short dark hair," - the dial changes the expression and keeps her the same. Anyone: keep it general, e.g. "a close-up photo of a person who is" - the practice pictures show a different person each time, so the dial learns only the change and works on anyone.
phrases.zh: 提示词的开头。每端的词会在其后以空格接上，需要逗号的话请在本行末尾带上。特定一人：描述她，如“一个大头照，短发深发的年轻女性，” —— 滑杆改变表情、保持她不变。任意人：保持泛化，如“一张人物特写照片，其人是” —— 练习图每次显示不同的人，滑杆便只学变化、对任何人都有效。

phrases.en: e.g. "happy" - with the general line above the prompt reads "a close-up photo of a person who is happy".
phrases.zh: 如“happy（开心）” —— 配合上面的泛化行，提示词读作“一张人物特写照片，其人是开心的”。

phrases.en: e.g. "sad". Words like this can bring more than a face (grey light, rain); if the whole scene changes, try a narrower word such as "unsmiling".
phrases.zh: 如“sad（难过）”。这类词可能带来的不止脸色（灰暗光线、下雨）；若整个场景都变了，试试更窄的词，如“unsmiling（不笑）”。

phrases.en: kohya keys, as every Fizgig Klein LoRA: the double blocks' attention and MLP Linears and the single blocks' linear1 / linear2 (modulation and norms excluded); ComfyUI reads them.
phrases.zh: kohya 键，与每个 Fizgig Klein LoRA 相同：双块的注意力和 MLP Linear，以及单块的 linear1 / linear2（调制与归一化除外）；ComfyUI 可读取。

phrases.en: MiniMax H3 DiT — the training base. Use the PRUNED int8 file (minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors, ~21 GB): it is the one ComfyUI runs, so your LoRA trains against the weights it will be deployed on, and its curve-table AdaLN is a target a LoRA can actually use. The ~66 GB bf16 file also works. The pruned file KEEPS its int8 weights (~21 GB on the GPU, what the reference trainer does); the bf16 file is quantized to NF4 at load (~11 GB, a little lossier).
phrases.zh: MiniMax H3 DiT —— 训练基座。请用 PRUNED int8 文件（minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors，约 21 GB）：它是 ComfyUI 运行的那个文件，你的 LoRA 训练的正是它将来部署的权重，其曲线表 AdaLN 也是 LoRA 真正能用的目标。约 66 GB 的 bf16 文件也可用。剪枝文件保留 int8 权重（GPU 上约 21 GB，与官方训练器一致）；bf16 文件加载时量化为 NF4（约 11 GB，损失略大）。

phrases.en: ~21GB — Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 → diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors (fl2va is the trainable variant; the 66GB bf16 file works too)
phrases.zh: ~21GB —— Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 → diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors（fl2va 是可训练变体；66GB 的 bf16 文件也可用）

phrases.en: OPTIONAL — used when the Training tab's Training Base is set to Reference (ref2va), and for reference distillation ('Learn identity from'). This is the ref2va model, a DIFFERENT fine-tune from the fl2va one above and not just another quantization of it: it is what ComfyUI's Reference-to-Video workflow loads, and the only H3 build that accepts reference images. A LoRA trained on it is most faithful deployed on it. Leave blank if you only train on the standard base.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— 当训练标签页的“训练基座”设为参考（ref2va）时使用，也用于参考蒸馏（“从我的数据集学习身份”）。这是 ref2va 模型，与上面的 fl2va 是不同的微调版本、不只是另一种量化：它是 ComfyUI 的 Reference-to-Video 工作流加载的模型，也是唯一接受参考图的 H3 版本。在它之上训练的 LoRA 部署到它上最忠实。只训标准基座则留空。

phrases.en: ~21GB — Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 -> diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors (the pruned int8 build, same shape as the fl2va one above; you may already have it if you use the r2v workflow)
phrases.zh: ~21GB —— Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 → diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors（剪枝 int8 版本，形状与上面的 fl2va 相同；如果你用 r2v 工作流可能已经有了）

phrases.en: Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder — nvfp4 (the compact ComfyUI file) or bf16 both work; the loader detects which you gave it. The nvfp4 file keeps its packed weights (~15.7 GB on the GPU); bf16 is NF4-quantized at load (~14 GB). Used only while caching caption embeddings, then offloaded before training. (The int8_convrot TE variant is NOT supported — its rotated weights can't be dequantized here.)
phrases.zh: Qwen3-VL-32B 文本编码器 —— nvfp4（紧凑的 ComfyUI 文件）或 bf16 都可用；加载器会自动识别。nvfp4 文件保留其打包权重（GPU 上约 15.7 GB）；bf16 加载时量化为 NF4（约 14 GB）。仅在缓存标注嵌入时使用，训练前卸载。（不支持 int8_convrot TE 变体 —— 其旋转权重无法在此反量化。）

phrases.en: ~15.7GB nvfp4-awq — the same TE ComfyUI uses, so you may already have it; identical conditioning to bf16 (validated), just a slower one-off load
phrases.zh: ~15.7GB nvfp4-awq —— 与 ComfyUI 使用的相同，可能已经有了；条件效果与 bf16 一致（已验证），只是首次加载较慢

phrases.en: ~51.5GB bf16 — the full-precision original; loads faster, 3.3x the disk
phrases.zh: ~51.5GB bf16 —— 全精度原版；加载更快，磁盘占用 3.3 倍

phrases.en: The H3 video VAE — encodes each training image to a 24-channel latent (used only during caching).
phrases.zh: H3 视频 VAE —— 把每张训练图编码为 24 通道潜变量（仅缓存时使用）。

phrases.en: OPTIONAL — set this to train on the sound in your video clips. H3 generates audio and video together, so a clip with sound can teach it a voice, and nothing else can. Used only during caching, and only by clips: a folder of stills never loads it, and neither does a clip you muted (a _mute on the filename trains that clip's video and ignores its sound). Leave blank and clips train silent, exactly as they did before.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— 设置后可训练视频片段中的声音。H3 音视频一体生成，带声片段能教它一个嗓音，别的都不行。仅缓存时、且仅被片段使用：静图文件夹从不加载它，被静音的片段也不加载（文件名带 _mute 则只训该片段的画面、忽略声音）。留空则片段照旧无声训练。

phrases.en: Audio VAE (~605 MB) — train on the sound in video clips, and on voices
phrases.zh: 音频 VAE（约 605 MB）—— 训练视频片段中的声音与嗓音

phrases.en: OPTIONAL — fast in-training previews. With this set, previews render in 6 steps with the community Turbo LoRA applied at 75% on top of your training LoRA — the same pairing fast ComfyUI inference uses — instead of the full 20-step pass. It touches PREVIEWS ONLY: the Turbo is switched in for the sample render and out again before the next training step, and your saved LoRA never contains it. Steps and strength are adjustable on the Samples tab.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— 快速训练中预览。设置后，预览用 6 步渲染：在你的训练 LoRA 之上以 75% 叠加社区 Turbo LoRA —— 与 ComfyUI 快速推理相同的组合 —— 取代完整的 20 步。仅影响预览：Turbo 仅在样本渲染时切入、下一步训练前切出，你保存的 LoRA 永远不含它。步数和强度可在“样本”标签页调整。

phrases.en: ~780MB — larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora → minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600.safetensors (you may already have it in ComfyUI's loras folder)
phrases.zh: ~780MB —— larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora → minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600.safetensors（ComfyUI 的 loras 文件夹里可能已经有了）

phrases.en: Turbo LoRA (~780 MB) — fast 6-step in-training previews
phrases.zh: Turbo LoRA（约 780 MB）—— 快速 6 步训练中预览

phrases.en: NEEDED when the Training adapter dropdown says Circlestone (the default) — one file for both bases (fl2va and ref2va). A frozen LoRA that de-distills the base while yours learns: sharper eyes, cleaner skin and better prompt-following than Ostris's on any dataset with stills. On for every training step, off for previews, never in your saved LoRA. The updater fetches it; so does the download button below.
phrases.zh: 当“训练适配器”下拉框为 Circlestone（默认）时需要 —— 一个文件适用两种基座（fl2va 和 ref2va）。一个冻结 LoRA，在你的 LoRA 学习的同时为基座去蒸馏：在任何静图数据集上比 Ostris 的更锐利的眼部、更干净的皮肤和更好的提示词遵循。每步训练开启、预览关闭、从不进入你保存的 LoRA。更新器会获取它；下方下载按钮也可以。

phrases.en: Training adapter (Circlestone, ~620 MB) — sharper, higher likeness
phrases.zh: 训练适配器（Circlestone，约 620 MB）—— 更锐利、相似度更高

phrases.en: OPTIONAL — Ostris's adapter for the standard fl2va base, used when the Training tab's adapter dropdown says Ostris: it learns a video look faster than Circlestone when the dataset is clips only.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— Ostris 为标准 fl2va 基座做的适配器，当训练标签页的适配器下拉框为 Ostris 时使用：数据集只有片段时，它学视频外观比 Circlestone 更快。

phrases.en: OPTIONAL — Ostris's adapter for the Reference (ref2va) base: picked automatically when the dropdown says Ostris and the Training Base is ref2va or the run is a distillation run.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— Ostris 为参考（ref2va）基座做的适配器：当适配器下拉框为 Ostris 且训练基座为 ref2va、或本轮是蒸馏运行时自动选用。

phrases.en: Previews default to 768×768 56-frame clips with sound; Sample length has stills and other lengths. 📖 Full write-ups in the README.
phrases.zh: 预览默认为 768×768 的 56 帧带声片段；“样本长度”里有静图和其他长度。📖 详细说明见 README。

phrases.en: (more suitable for larger datasets with longer trains)
phrases.zh: （更适合大数据集、更长的训练）

phrases.en: Preview prompts rendered periodically during training, as short clips on the model being trained. Samples land in <output_dir>/sample/ and the Gallery button below opens the viewer.
phrases.zh: 训练期间按预览提示词周期性渲染的短片，用正在训练的模型。样本落在 <output_dir>/sample/，下方的图库按钮打开查看器。

phrases.en: H3 renders CFG-free on a fixed schedule, so the knobs it does not use are greyed out.
phrases.zh: H3 在固定调度上免 CFG 渲染，因此它不用的旋钮被置灰。

phrases.en: Fixed at 12 for H3 — the schedule every shipped workflow uses
phrases.zh: H3 固定为 12 —— 所有官方工作流用的调度

phrases.en: Unused — H3 samples render without CFG
phrases.zh: 未使用 —— H3 样本免 CFG 渲染

phrases.en: H3 renders without CFG; the shipped workflow does the same
phrases.zh: H3 免 CFG 渲染；官方工作流相同

phrases.en: 20 steps matches the shipped H3 workflow
phrases.zh: 20 步与官方 H3 工作流一致

phrases.en: Image-only LoRA training for MiniMax's ~33B H3 omni DiT. Train on the pruned int8 DiT — the same file ComfyUI runs — quantized to NF4 at load, so the resident base is ~11 GB. The Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder and the video VAE are only needed for the one-time caching pass; the compact nvfp4 TE is recommended. Trains on stills, or on short video clips — and with the audio VAE set, on their sound too.
phrases.zh: 针对 MiniMax 约 33B 的 H3 全能 DiT 的纯图 LoRA 训练。在剪枝 int8 DiT 上训练 —— 与 ComfyUI 运行的同一文件 —— 加载时量化为 NF4，常驻基座约 11 GB。Qwen3-VL-32B 文本编码器和视频 VAE 仅一次性缓存时需要；推荐紧凑的 nvfp4 文本编码器。可训练静图或短视频片段 —— 设置音频 VAE 后还可训练其声音。

phrases.en: Fetches the DiT, text encoder, both VAEs, the Turbo LoRA and the three training adapters above, plus the Krea 2 Qwen3-VL captioning text encoder (~47 GB all in), and fills in these paths for you — plus the small helper models (Florence-2 captioner, face model for the Look Filter and likeness scoring, EN→ZH translator, Gizmo's Whisper transcriber — ~1.9 GB) so nothing stalls to download later and everything works offline. No HuggingFace account needed — none of these are gated. The reference DiT is left out unless you tick it above: another 21 GB, and it is only used by identity mode.
phrases.zh: 获取上述 DiT、文本编码器、两个 VAE、Turbo LoRA 和三个训练适配器，外加 Krea 2 的 Qwen3-VL 标注文本编码器（合计约 47 GB），并为你填好这些路径 —— 还包括小型辅助模型（Florence-2 标注器、用于 Look Filter 与相似度评分的人脸模型、英→中翻译器、Gizmo 的 Whisper 转写器 —— 约 1.9 GB），之后不会再卡在下载上，一切可离线使用。无需 HuggingFace 账号 —— 这些都不需要许可。参考 DiT 除非你在上方勾选否则不含：另有 21 GB，且仅身份模式使用。

phrases.en: Fizgig can now train on video, sound and voices, and render fast Turbo previews.
phrases.zh: Fizgig 现在可以训练视频、声音与嗓音，并渲染快速 Turbo 预览。

phrases.en: See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh: 详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: Stream blocks (exact int8, room for big clips)
phrases.zh: 流式块（精确 int8，大片段也有余量）

phrases.en: Block ids follow the old Repair Studio (h3blk_0-49, h3_rf_0-1), so its saved presets apply.
phrases.zh: 块 id 沿用旧版修复工作室（h3blk_0-49、h3_rf_0-1），其保存的预设仍然适用。

phrases.en: kohya keys as the old H3 trainer writes them (create_network(None, 'lora_unet', ...)); the AdaLN projection is left out by default (--no_train_adaln).
phrases.zh: kohya 键，按旧版 H3 训练器的写法（create_network(None, 'lora_unet', ...)）；默认不含 AdaLN 投影（--no_train_adaln）。

phrases.en: int8 · most accurate, needs ~30 GB free
phrases.zh: int8 · 最精确，需要约 30 GB 空闲
4-bit HQQ · 误差比 4-bit 低，更慢

phrases.en: Auto reads free VRAM at launch and picks precision and block swap together. int8 is the most accurate, 4-bit fits smaller cards, 4-bit HQQ sits between (less error, more VRAM, slower with no swap). Auto never picks HQQ.
phrases.zh: 自动在启动时读取空闲显存并同时选择精度与块交换。int8 最精确，4-bit 适配较小显卡，4-bit HQQ 居中（误差更小、显存更多、无交换时更慢）。自动从不选 HQQ。

phrases.en: A smoothed average of the weights, leading to better and more reliable previews.
phrases.zh: 权重的平滑平均，带来更好、更稳定的预览。

phrases.en: CFG-free on the fixed shift-12 schedule, as the shipped ComfyUI workflows.
phrases.zh: 在固定的 shift-12 调度上免 CFG，与官方 ComfyUI 工作流一致。

phrases.en: CFG-free; the old previews' 6 steps at 0.75.
phrases.zh: 免 CFG；旧预览的 6 步、0.75 强度。
相似与风格 —— 60% 干净端

phrases.en: Reference (ref2va) if the LoRA lives in the r2v workflow; needs DiT (reference) in Preferences.
phrases.zh: 若 LoRA 用于 r2v 工作流则选参考（ref2va）；需要在偏好设置中配置 DiT（参考）。
模型默认，偏重动态 —— 8% 干净端

phrases.en: Most of the run on nearly-clean images — the tuned default for stills. See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh: 大部分训练在近干净图片上 —— 为静图调优的默认。详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: The reference trainer's schedule, weighted to movement and composition. See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh: 官方训练器的调度，偏重动态与构图。详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: Type your own clean-end share. See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh: 输入你自己的干净端占比。详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: Scales the LR of the noisy-half steps: pose, framing, face shape. Leave at 100 unless experimenting.
phrases.zh: 缩放噪声偏高那半步数的学习率：姿势、构图、脸型。除非做实验，保持 100。

phrases.en: %  — best left at 100 unless you are experimenting.

phrases.zh: 锚定在 10% 学习率（推荐）

phrases.en: Finish the smaller category early, before it overbakes. Blank = both train to the end. Anchor holds it at 10% LR and keeps its epoch report live. Stop skips its steps: faster, but unwatched.
phrases.zh: 让较小的类别提前结束，免得过火。留空 = 两者都训到最后。锚定让它保持 10% 学习率、其 epoch 报告仍在。停止则跳过其步数：更快，但无人看管。

phrases.en: Off · hand-pick the blocks in Other Options
phrases.zh: 关闭 · 在其他选项中手动选块

phrases.en: High quality, versatile, best at preserving model priors. Photos, clips and voice all train blocks 20-49, and the backward stops at the window so the steps are quicker too.
phrases.zh: 高质量、通用、最能保留模型先验。照片、片段和语音都训练 20-49 块，反向传播止于窗口，步数也更快。

phrases.en: Less preservation of model priors, high quality. May help when you are training a MOTION concept specifically, since it reaches more of the model. It is not a likeness upgrade — Default reaches higher likeness, sooner, with quicker steps — and Default may well be enough for motion too. Every step type trains 6-49, at 44 blocks in the backward instead of 30. Blocks 0-5 stay out either way; they deform anatomy and colour.
phrases.zh: 对模型先验保留较少，高质量。专门训练“动态”概念时可能有帮助，因为它触及模型更多部分。它不是相似度升级 —— 默认模式更早达到更高相似度、步数更快 —— 且默认对动态多半也够了。每种步都训 6-49，反向传播 44 个块而非 30 个。0-5 块两种模式都不训：它们会让解剖结构和色彩变形。

phrases.en: The blocks are yours to pick, for experiments: Blocks to Train, in the Other Options section further down this tab.
phrases.zh: 块由你自己挑，用于实验：本标签页下方的“其他选项”里的“要训练的块”。

phrases.en: De-distills the base while your LoRA learns: frozen at 1.0 for every training step, off for previews and never in your saved file. Circlestone (one file for fl2va and ref2va) trains sharper LoRAs from photos; Ostris learns a video look faster. For mixed datasets, choose by whether the photos or the videos are the priority.
phrases.zh: 在你的 LoRA 学习的同时为基座去蒸馏：每步训练固定 1.0，预览关闭，从不进入你保存的文件。Circlestone（一个文件适用 fl2va 和 ref2va）从照片训出更锐利的 LoRA；Ostris 学视频外观更快。混合数据集按照片还是视频更重要来选。

phrases.en: TREAD token routing — on clip steps, half the video tokens skip the middle blocks
phrases.zh: TREAD token 路由 —— 片段步中一半视频 token 跳过中间块

phrases.en: Faster clip steps: a random half of each clip's video tokens skips blocks 2-46 and rejoins unchanged. Photos and clip stills always run in full; previews and your saved LoRA are untouched. See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh: 更快的片段步：每个片段视频 token 的随机一半跳过 2-46 块并无变化地汇合。照片和片段静图始终完整运行；预览和你保存的 LoRA 不受影响。详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: Also train each clip's sharpest face frame as a photo
phrases.zh: 同时把每个片段最清晰的人脸帧当作照片训练

phrases.en: Each clip's sharpest face frame trains as a photo with the clip's caption. Picked at caching; clips cached with this off use frame 0 until re-cached.
phrases.zh: 每个片段最清晰的人脸帧带片段的标注当作照片训练。缓存时选取；关闭此项缓存的片段在重新缓存前用第 0 帧。

phrases.en: Makes the Learning Rate box a ceiling the run climbs toward. Set it where you want to end up.
phrases.zh: 把学习率框变成运行爬向的上限。把终点设成你想要的值。

phrases.en: Trains a few percent of steps with no caption, so the LoRA does not lean entirely on the trigger word.
phrases.zh: 让百分之几的步不带标注训练，LoRA 便不会完全依赖触发词。

phrases.en: Train a subset of the 50 blocks. Type ranges and singles, comma-separated, like 3-12, 22, 31-33. Measured answers: 6-49 for the whole model (what More Blocks runs) and 20-49 for likeness (Default). Blocks 0-5 are in neither: they deform anatomy and pull the dataset's colour into the render.
phrases.zh: 训练 50 个块的子集。输入范围和单块，逗号分隔，如 3-12, 22, 31-33。实测结论：整个模型用 6-49（即“更多块”跑的），相似度用 20-49（默认）。0-5 块都不在推荐里：它们会让解剖变形并把数据集的颜色拉进渲染。

phrases.en: Set by Training mode (Default): blocks 20-49 for photos, clips and voice. To choose the blocks yourself, set Training mode to Off.
phrases.zh: 由训练模式（默认）设定：照片、片段和语音训练 20-49 块。要自己选块，请把训练模式设为关闭。

phrases.en: Set by Training mode (More Blocks): blocks 6-49 for photos, clips and voice. To choose the blocks yourself, set Training mode to Off.
phrases.zh: 由训练模式（更多块）设定：照片、片段和语音训练 6-49 块。要自己选块，请把训练模式设为关闭。

phrases.en: Learn identity from my dataset (reference distillation)
phrases.zh: 从我的数据集学习身份（参考蒸馏）

phrases.en: Experiment. Teaches the LoRA to reproduce identity the way H3 does from a reference photo. Needs the ref2va model in Preferences.
phrases.zh: 实验性。教 LoRA 以 H3 从参考照片复现身份的方式学习。需要在偏好设置中配置 ref2va 模型。
训练文本 token 精炼器

phrases.en: Recommended off. Does not affect the ability to use a trigger word. The refiner sets how every prompt is read; training it softens output and makes previews judder between epochs. LoRA and fine-tune runs alike (under fine-tune it would train alongside every window, four times the duty cycle of any block).
phrases.zh: 建议关闭。不影响使用触发词的能力。精炼器决定每条提示词的读取方式；训练它会让输出变软、预览在 epoch 之间抖动。LoRA 与微调运行同理（微调时它会随每个窗口一起训练，占空比是任何块的四倍）。

phrases.en: A dataset FILTER, not a mode. All media fine-tunes on everything in the folder - photos, clips, voice. Photos only skips the clips and voice of a mixed folder (with Training mode on Default the cycle then tightens to the identity blocks).
phrases.zh: 是数据集过滤器，不是模式。全部媒体对文件夹里的一切微调 —— 照片、片段、语音。仅照片跳过混合文件夹的片段和语音（训练模式为默认时循环会收紧到身份块）。

phrases.en: Optional: restrict the rotation cycle to a block range - the whole fine-tune touches only these blocks. 20-49 is the measured likeness recipe (protects the fragile 0-19 trunk) and roughly halves the system-RAM master copy. Empty = the full model.
phrases.zh: 可选：把轮换循环限定在一个块范围 —— 整个微调只触及这些块。20-49 是实测的相似度配方（保护脆弱的 0-19 干线）并大致省一半系统内存主副本。留空 = 整个模型。

phrases.en: The size your video clips are cached and trained at; photos keep the Target Megapixels. A clip takes far more memory and time than a photo of the same size, so e.g. photos at 1.0 with clips at 0.25 keeps caching and training fast. A clip that would not fit in your card's free memory is cached smaller still.
phrases.zh: 视频片段缓存与训练的尺寸；照片仍按目标百万像素。同尺寸的片段比照片耗内存和时间多得多，所以比如照片 1.0、片段 0.25 可保持缓存和训练快速。放不进显卡空闲内存的片段会被缓存得更小。

phrases.en: Short run (window = ¼ of the run)
phrases.zh: 短训练（窗口 = 训练的 ¼）

phrases.en: Photo pairs: two folders of the same shots, one for each end of the dial (e.g. the same person smiling, and not smiling). 4 to 10 pairs, each pair framed the same. For a dial about people, use a different person in each pair if you can: the dial then learns only the change, and works on anyone. A dial about something else (lighting, colour, a scene) works the same way: the same subject at both ends of a pair, and a different one in each pair. Clips work too: a pair can be two clips with the same file name, the +1 clip and the same clip with the look you want at the other end (a frame-skip look, a visual effect, a rendering style). Looks that only exist in motion train this way, and the previews play -1, 0 and +1 side by side as one clip.
phrases.zh: 照片对：两个文件夹放相同照片、各对应滑杆一端（如同一人微笑与不微笑）。4 到 10 对，每对取景相同。人物滑杆尽量每对用不同的人：滑杆便只学变化、对任何人都有效。其他主题（灯光、色彩、场景）同理：一对两端同一主体，每对换一个主体。片段也可以：一对可以是两个同名片段，+1 片段和同一片段的另一种外观（跳帧感、视效、渲染风格）。只存在于动态中的外观可用这种方式训练，预览会把 -1、0、+1 并排播成一个片段。

phrases.en:
Each subject is a folder of their photos, with their own trigger word in every caption - that is how the LoRA tells them apart. Caption each folder first.
Up to 4 people work well, with 2 or 3 of them in one picture. With a person the model already knows well in the picture too: 2 subjects is reliable, 3 is hit and miss. See the MiniMax section of the README.
phrases.zh:
每个主体是一个放其照片的文件夹，每条标注含其专属触发词 —— LoRA 以此区分他们。请先为每个文件夹写标注。
最多 4 人效果良好，其中 2-3 人可同框。若同框的还有模型熟知的人：2 个主体可靠，3 个时好时坏。详见 README 的 MiniMax 章节。

phrases.en: Previews render in these few steps with the H3 Turbo LoRA (6-step) at this strength on top of your training LoRA - previews only, never the saved LoRA. 6 steps at 75% is the tested recommendation; without the Turbo, the Steps box applies.
phrases.zh: 预览以这么多步渲染：在你的训练 LoRA 之上叠加该强度的 H3 Turbo LoRA（6 步）—— 仅预览，从不进入保存的 LoRA。6 步 75% 是实测推荐；无 Turbo 时以步数框为准。

phrases.en: Set the H3 Turbo LoRA (6-step) in Preferences for fast Turbo previews; without it previews use the plain model.
phrases.zh: 在偏好设置中配置 H3 Turbo LoRA（6 步）以获得快速 Turbo 预览；未配置时预览用原模型。

phrases.en: A RefMod runs on MiniMax H3's files (set in Preferences under MiniMax H3). Reference (ref2va) is the model a RefMod rides at generation.
phrases.zh: RefMod 运行于 MiniMax H3 的文件之上（在偏好设置的 MiniMax H3 下配置）。参考（ref2va）是 RefMod 生成时所骑的模型。

phrases.en: Where the mod is saved: <name>.safetensors. Point it at ComfyUI/models/refmods and the mod is ready to load. Empty (or Reset to default) uses the LoRA output folder in Preferences.
phrases.zh: mod 的保存位置：<name>.safetensors。指向 ComfyUI/models/refmods 即可直接加载。留空（或“恢复默认”）则使用偏好设置中的 LoRA 输出文件夹。
完整参考（推荐 —— 带人脸）

phrases.en: 0 (plain encode — what the node pack makes)

phrases.zh: 200（针对 H3 优化 —— 推荐）

phrases.en: How a clip in the dataset enters the mod. Sharpest still: one frame, the face - the identity choice. Motion: every latent frame of the clip, the node pack's video reference (a dance, a camera move); tokens are per frame, so a clip costs its length. Prepare clips with Gizmo first — cut to H3's frame grid at the right size, they work best.
phrases.zh: 数据集中的片段如何进入 mod。最清晰静帧：单帧、人脸 —— 身份之选。动态：片段的每个潜帧，节点包的视频参考（一段舞、一个运镜）；token 按帧计费，片段的成本即其长度。请先用 Gizmo 准备片段 —— 按 H3 帧网格剪到合适尺寸，效果最好。

phrases.en: A few words saying what the mod is — 'a ginger woman with messy hair', 'a 1970s film look'. Stored in the file; RefMod Toolkit's '+ mod hints' and the pack's loader put 'concept: description' into the prompt so the model knows what it is looking at.
phrases.zh: 几个词说明这个 mod 是什么 —— “一个红发凌乱的女人”、“1970 年代胶片感”。存在文件里；RefMod 工具包的“+ mod 提示”和节点包加载器会把“concept: 描述”放进提示词，模型便知道它在看什么。

phrases.en: What the mod is, in the pack's terms: identity (a person), style (a look), pose_motion (a dance, a camera move), clothing, background, generic.
