phrases.zh: 按节点包的说法 mod 是什么：identity（人物）、style（外观）、pose_motion（舞蹈、运镜）、clothing（服装）、background（背景）、generic（通用）。
片段 token 上限（静图不受影响）

phrases.en: For clips as motion only: thin their frames to fit a token budget the way the pack's extractor thins a clip. Only when the mod is over the cap, each clip loses the frames that are near-duplicates of the last kept one (a held shot is mostly those), then what is left is spread evenly down to what fits. Photos are never touched, whatever the cap; with no motion clips this does nothing. Off keeps every frame.
phrases.zh: 仅对按动态处理的片段：像节点包提取器那样抽稀帧数以符合 token 预算。仅当 mod 超出上限时，每个片段丢弃与上一个保留帧近乎重复的帧（长镜头多是这种帧），剩下的均匀摊开到放得下为止。无论上限多少照片都不受影响；没有动态片段则无操作。关闭保留每一帧。

phrases.en: Also make an audio mod: the folder's sound (each clip's soundtrack and any audio file, in file order) through the H3 audio VAE, the pack's audio RefMod. One file puts it in <name>.safetensors beside the visual mod (the pack's bundle; needs the current pack). Two files writes it as <name>_audio.safetensors, which any version reads. A clip Gizmo marked mute (_mute in its name) lends no sound, the same rule as H3 training. A plain encode, no training. Needs the Audio VAE path in Preferences. RefMod Toolkit renders visual mods only; audio mods play in ComfyUI.
phrases.zh: 同时制作音频 mod：文件夹的声音（每个片段的音轨及任何音频文件，按文件顺序）经 H3 音频 VAE，即节点包的音频 RefMod。单文件模式把它写进 <name>.safetensors、与视觉 mod 并存（节点包的捆绑格式；需当前版本节点包）。双文件模式写为 <name>_audio.safetensors，任何版本都能读。Gizmo 里标记静音的片段（名字带 _mute）不出借声音，与 H3 训练同规则。纯编码、无训练。需要在偏好设置中配置音频 VAE 路径。RefMod 工具包只渲染视觉 mod；音频 mod 在 ComfyUI 中播放。

phrases.en: on: one file — the visual mod plus an audio mod of the folder's sound
phrases.zh: 开启：单文件 —— 视觉 mod 加文件夹声音的音频 mod

phrases.en: on: two files — the visual mod, and an audio mod of the folder's sound beside it
phrases.zh: 开启：双文件 —— 视觉 mod，旁边一个文件夹声音的音频 mod

phrases.en: What the sound is, in the pack's terms: voice, singing, music_style, sound_fx, ambience. Stored in the file as its concept type.
phrases.zh: 按节点包的说法声音是什么：voice（嗓音）、singing（歌唱）、music_style（音乐风格）、sound_fx（音效）、ambience（环境声）。作为概念类型存在文件里。

phrases.en: Steps 0 writes the plain encode (no captions needed). Steps above 0 optimise the mod against H3: level on shots like your photos, well ahead on looks they never showed, cleaner skin in both. RefMods make no previews: judge a mod in RefMod Toolkit.
phrases.zh: 步数为 0 写入纯编码（无需标注）。步数大于 0 则针对 H3 优化 mod：与你照片相近的镜头持平，从未展示过的外观明显领先，两者皮肤都更干净。RefMod 不生成预览：请在 RefMod 工具包里评判 mod。

phrases.en: Prepare the cache before making the mod
phrases.zh: 制作 mod 前准备缓存

phrases.en: RefMods have no previews, so this tab isn't used. Judge a mod in the desktop app's RefMod Toolkit once it is made.
phrases.zh: RefMod 没有预览，因此本标签页不使用。mod 做好后请在桌面应用的 RefMod 工具包里评判。

phrases.en: ✨ RefMod — community recipe (plain encode, 8 refs at 1 MP)
phrases.zh: ✨ RefMod —— 社区配方（纯编码，8 张 1 百万像素参考）

phrases.en: ✨ RefMod — Fizgig recipe (Full reference, 16 refs at 1 MP, optimised)
phrases.zh: ✨ RefMod —— Fizgig 配方（完整参考，16 张 1 百万像素参考，优化）

phrases.en: ✨ RefMod — Fizgig recipe lite (Full reference, 16 refs at 0.5 MP, optimised)
phrases.zh: ✨ RefMod —— Fizgig 配方精简版（完整参考，16 张 0.5 百万像素参考，优化）

phrases.en: ✨ RefMod — style, community (16×16 grid, all refs, plain encode)
phrases.zh: ✨ RefMod —— 风格，社区（16×16 网格，全部参考，纯编码）

phrases.en: ✨ RefMod — style, high fidelity (Full at 1 MP, 8 refs, plain encode)
phrases.zh: ✨ RefMod —— 风格，高保真（完整参考 1 百万像素，8 张参考，纯编码）

phrases.en: The undistilled base the LoRA trains on.
phrases.zh: LoRA 训练所用的未蒸馏基座。

phrases.en: Used for caching only, then unloaded before training steps. fp8_scaled: 3.4 GB less VRAM than bf16, virtually identical output.
phrases.zh: 仅缓存时使用，训练步之前卸载。fp8_scaled：比 bf16 少 3.4 GB 显存，输出几乎一致。
在训练模型上做 8 步预览。

phrases.en: Optional: Repair Studio and LoRA Royale preview on it by default (8-step, CFG-free); without it they use the Turbo LoRA on the RAW model.
phrases.zh: 可选：修复工作室和 LoRA 竞技场默认在它上面预览（8 步、免 CFG）；没有它则用 RAW 模型上的 Turbo LoRA。

phrases.en: an abliterated fine-tune of Qwen3-VL-4B (community build)
phrases.zh: Qwen3-VL-4B 的消融微调（社区版本）

phrases.en: 💡 Already have these files for ComfyUI? Filling the paths in by hand works perfectly — the download button is a convenience, not a requirement. The first time you caption or train while online, Fizgig quietly fetches a few tiny helper files and keeps them, and from then on everything runs fully offline. Setting up a machine that will never see the internet? Paste a complete HuggingFace model folder into the text encoder field instead of a single file and nothing needs downloading at all.
phrases.zh: 💡 已经为 ComfyUI 备好这些文件？手动填路径完全可行 —— 下载按钮只是便利，不是必需。首次在线标注或训练时，Fizgig 会悄悄获取并保留几个小辅助文件，此后一切完全离线运行。要配置一台永不见网的机器？把完整的 HuggingFace 模型文件夹（而非单个文件）粘贴进文本编码器字段，就什么都不用下载。

phrases.en: The LoRA also covers the text-fusion stack and the input / timestep / output layers (264 Linears in all), as the original Krea 2 trainer does.
phrases.zh: LoRA 同时覆盖文本融合栈与输入 / 时间步 / 输出层（共 264 个 Linear），与原版 Krea 2 训练器一致。

phrases.en: kohya keys (module path with dots as underscores), as every Fizgig Krea 2 LoRA; ComfyUI reads them.
phrases.zh: kohya 键（模块路径的点写作下划线），与每个 Fizgig Krea 2 LoRA 相同；ComfyUI 可读取。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) turns torch.compile on only when this run is long enough to repay it. It fuses the per-matmul quantise/dequantise work that bounds the INT8 and NF4 paths — 2.0× per step on INT8 (0.59 → 0.29 s/step, matching OneTrainer) and 1.28× on NF4 (0.71 → 0.56) — but costs a ~90 s compile pause first, so a short run is SLOWER overall. Break-even is around 600 steps on INT8, 1200 on NF4. NF4 + compile still fits a 16 GB card (verified under a 13.5 GB cap). INT8 + compile fits from ~22 GB free: at high resolution the checkpoint automatically moves outside the compiled region, which keeps memory at eager levels (~18 GB at 1024px, measured ~27% faster than uncompiled). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) — both located automatically. Never used with Blocks Swap, since swapping moves weights and compiled graphs assume they stay put.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）仅在本轮训练长到能回本时才开启 torch.compile。它融合了限制 INT8 与 NF4 路径的逐矩阵乘量化/反量化工作 —— INT8 每步 2.0 倍（0.59 → 0.29 秒/步，与 OneTrainer 持平），NF4 上 1.28 倍（0.71 → 0.56）—— 但先要约 90 秒编译停顿，短训练整体反而更慢。盈亏平衡点约为 INT8 600 步、NF4 1200 步。NF4 + 编译仍可进 16 GB 显卡（在 13.5 GB 上限下验证过）。INT8 + 编译需要约 22 GB 空闲起：高分辨率下检查点会自动移出编译区，内存保持在 eager 水平（1024px 约 18 GB，实测比不编译快约 27%）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。从不与块交换同时使用，因为交换会移动权重，而编译图假定它们不动。

phrases.en: The distilled Turbo: CFG-free, mu pinned at 1.15, as the original workbench.
phrases.zh: 蒸馏 Turbo：免 CFG，mu 固定为 1.15，与原版工作台一致。
未蒸馏模型：带引导，约 28 步。

phrases.en: mu pinned at 1.15, as the original previews.
phrases.zh: mu 固定为 1.15，与原版预览一致。
✨ Krea 2 极速（rank 8，自适应学习率）

phrases.en: Timesteps: logit-normal with a resolution-dependent shift (mu 0.5 at 256 image tokens to 1.15 at 6400), unweighted MSE on the flow-matching velocity.
phrases.zh: 时间步：logit-normal 配分辨率相关的 shift（256 个图像 token 时 mu 0.5，6400 时 1.15），对流匹配速度做无加权 MSE。

phrases.en: How hard the ends are pushed apart. Higher gives a stronger dial but changes more than the one thing you asked for (a frown can turn into a different, older man). Start on 3. You can change the prompts and this while it trains, on the Run card.
phrases.zh: 两端被推开的力度。更高滑杆更强，但改变的不止你要求的那一件事（皱眉可能变成另一个更老的人）。从 3 开始。训练期间可以在运行卡片上修改提示词和此项。

phrases.en: Allows use at a much higher range of strengths. Affects fine detail less than a regular slider LoRA. Best for sliders from prompts; with photo pairs, best when the change is compositional (pose, framing, layout).
phrases.zh: 允许使用高得多的强度范围。对细节的影响比普通滑杆 LoRA 小。最适合从提示词做滑杆；照片对则在变化是构图性的（姿势、取景、布局）时最佳。

phrases.en: 0 = off: full-quality previews (8 steps, CFG 1). 1 = on: the Krea 2 Turbo LoRA (8-step) renders previews in 10 steps, CFG 1, much faster but softer, so they undersell your LoRA. Steps and CFG switch with it. Previews only, never the saved LoRA. Default 0.7.
phrases.zh: 0 = 关：全质量预览（8 步，CFG 1）。1 = 开：Krea 2 Turbo LoRA（8 步）以 10 步、CFG 1 渲染预览，快得多但更软，会低估你的 LoRA。步数和 CFG 随之切换。仅预览，从不进入保存的 LoRA。默认 0.7。

phrases.en: Set the Krea 2 Turbo LoRA (8-step) in Preferences for fast Turbo previews; without it previews use the plain model.
phrases.zh: 在偏好设置中配置 Krea 2 Turbo LoRA（8 步）以获得快速 Turbo 预览；未配置时预览用原模型。

phrases.en: Optional - fed through Krea 2's text encoder vision path so previews become visually aware of it ('prompt from a picture', not a pixel edit). Leave empty for normal previews.
phrases.zh: 可选 —— 经 Krea 2 文本编码器的视觉通路输入，预览便对它有视觉感知（“从图片出发的提示”，而非像素编辑）。留空则正常预览。

phrases.en: 1 = no CFG. Above 1 the negative prompt applies.
phrases.zh: 1 = 无 CFG。高于 1 时负面提示词生效。

phrases.en: bf16 base for training. ComfyUI's single file ships the MLP pre-fused (gate_up).
phrases.zh: 用于训练的 bf16 基座。ComfyUI 单文件自带预融合 MLP（gate_up）。

phrases.en: Its own VAE (64 latent channels, 16x, RGBA), the diffusers-format file from the official repo. Not the Krea 2 / Qwen-Image VAE.
phrases.zh: 它自己的 VAE（64 个潜通道，16 倍，RGBA），官方仓库的 diffusers 格式文件。不是 Krea 2 / Qwen-Image 的 VAE。

phrases.en: Used for caching only, then unloaded before training steps.
phrases.zh: 仅缓存时使用，训练步之前卸载。

phrases.en: Frozen during training, off in previews and saved LoRAs. Without it Qwen 2.1 LoRAs collapse or wobble; with it likeness was 77 vs 56 in Fizgig's A/B.
phrases.zh: 训练时冻结，预览和保存的 LoRA 中关闭。没有它 Qwen 2.1 LoRA 会崩溃或抖动；有它在 Fizgig 的 A/B 中相似度为 77 对 56。

phrases.en: Fast in-training previews on the model being trained (8 steps, CFG 1). Applied unmerged.
phrases.zh: 在训练中的模型上快速训练中预览（8 步，CFG 1）。以未合并方式应用。

phrases.en: Repair Studio and LoRA Royale preview on it (8 steps, CFG 1); training previews can use it too (a tick on the Samples tab).
phrases.zh: 修复工作室和 LoRA 竞技场在它上面预览（8 步，CFG 1）；训练预览也可以用（在“样本”标签页勾选）。

phrases.en: Preview prompts rendered periodically during training, on the Qwen Image 2.1 model being trained (or the Turbo model when ticked below). Samples land in <output_dir>/sample/ and the Gallery button below opens the viewer.
phrases.zh: 训练期间按预览提示词周期性渲染，用正在训练的 Qwen Image 2.1 模型（或下方勾选时的 Turbo 模型）。样本落在 <output_dir>/sample/，下方的图库按钮打开查看器。

phrases.en: Qwen Image 2.1's sampling settings: the negative prompt and CFG Scale.
phrases.zh: Qwen Image 2.1 的采样设置：负面提示词与 CFG 比例。

phrases.en: Not used for Qwen Image 2.1 previews
Used when CFG Scale is above 1 - the Turbo samples don't use it
phrases.zh: CFG 比例高于 1 时使用 —— Turbo 样本不用它

phrases.en: 3 = Fizgig's default for plain-model previews (25 steps); 1 = no CFG, twice as fast. The Turbo samples always use CFG 1.
phrases.zh: 3 = Fizgig 对原模型预览的默认（25 步）；1 = 无 CFG，快一倍。Turbo 样本始终用 CFG 1。

phrases.en: Modulation is shared across all blocks (one global Linear), so per-block sliders act on attention and MLP only. Identity sits in blocks 10-14 (measured 2 Oct 2026 with the Profiler on two character LoRAs: those five alone give 67-89% of the likeness, leaving them out removes 82-84%, block 12 the strongest); the rest shape the picture.
phrases.zh: 调制由所有块共享（一个全局 Linear），因此逐块滑杆只作用于注意力和 MLP。身份位于 10-14 块（2026 年 10 月 2 日用分析器在两个角色 LoRA 上实测：仅这五个块就贡献 67-89% 的相似度，去掉它们损失 82-84%，块 12 最强）；其余块塑造画面。

phrases.en: Approved exception to the kohya-key rule (Peter, 26 Sep 2026): ComfyUI maps gate_layer/proj onto the halves of its fused gate_up only for bare or transformer.-prefixed keys; lora_unet_ / diffusion_model. keys silently drop the MLP input on the fused checkpoint.
phrases.zh: kohya 键规则的批准例外（Peter，2026 年 9 月 26 日）：ComfyUI 只对裸键或 transformer. 前缀的键把 gate_layer/proj 映射到融合 gate_up 的两半；lora_unet_ / diffusion_model. 键会在融合检查点上悄悄丢掉 MLP 输入。

phrases.en: Keeps Qwen 2.1 LoRA training stable: frozen at 1.0 for every training step, off for previews and never in your saved file. Without it Qwen 2.1 LoRAs collapse or wobble (likeness 77 with it vs 56 without in Fizgig's A/B).
phrases.zh: 保持 Qwen 2.1 LoRA 训练稳定：每步训练固定 1.0，预览关闭，从不进入你保存的文件。没有它 Qwen 2.1 LoRA 会崩溃或抖动（Fizgig 的 A/B 中有它相似度 77、没有 56）。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) turns torch.compile on only when this run is long enough to repay it. On Qwen Image 2.1 it is measured 1.43x per step on the INT8 base (2.00 -> 2.86 it/s) and about 1.15x on bf16 (2.04 -> 2.33), with no extra memory: the gradient checkpoint stays outside the compiled blocks. The first epoch runs slower while the blocks compile, so Auto waits for runs longer than about 300 steps on INT8 and 800 on bf16; NF4 is not compiled by Auto (On still compiles). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) - both located automatically. Never used with Blocks Swap, since swapping moves weights and compiled graphs assume they stay put.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）仅在本轮训练长到能回本时才开启 torch.compile。在 Qwen Image 2.1 上实测：INT8 基座每步 1.43 倍（2.00 -> 2.86 it/s），bf16 约 1.15 倍（2.04 -> 2.33），无额外显存：梯度检查点在编译块之外。第一个 epoch 因块编译而较慢，所以自动模式会等训练超过约 300 步（INT8）或 800 步（bf16）；NF4 不被自动编译（手动开启仍会编译）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。从不与块交换同时使用，因为交换会移动权重，而编译图假定它们不动。

phrases.en: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo: 8 steps, CFG 1, its own sigmas with no shift.
phrases.zh: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo：8 步，CFG 1，自带 sigma 无 shift。

phrases.en: Use the Turbo model for samples (8-step, CFG 1 - set it in Preferences)
phrases.zh: 样本使用 Turbo 模型（8 步，CFG 1 —— 在偏好设置中配置）

phrases.en: Plain-model samples - the Turbo samples use their own 8 steps
phrases.zh: 原模型样本 —— Turbo 样本用它自己的 8 步

phrases.en: About 40 pairs (20 at least; more if your photos vary a lot). Each photo 1 MP or larger, e.g. 1200x800; bigger is fine, Fizgig resizes them. An original and its edited version must have the same crop and shape.
phrases.zh: 约 40 对（至少 20 对；照片变化大则更多）。每张照片 1 百万像素或更大，如 1200x800；更大也行，Fizgig 会自动调整。原图与编辑版必须同裁剪同形状。

phrases.en: 1 MP default; model shift 0.69 (mu) built in, no ModelSampling node.
phrases.zh: 默认 1 百万像素；模型 shift 0.69（mu）已内置，无需 ModelSampling 节点。

phrases.en: FlowMatch Euler, dynamic exponential shift (mu 0.5 at 256 tokens to 0.9 at 8192), shift_terminal 0.02. 'Meant to be sampled without guidance.'
phrases.zh: FlowMatch Euler，动态指数 shift（256 token 时 mu 0.5，8192 时 0.9），shift_terminal 0.02。“设计为无引导采样。”

phrases.en: Community claim: CFG ~3-3.5 with 30-50 steps is more coherent than CFG 1; 25 steps shows banding that is gone at 35-40.
phrases.zh: 社区结论：CFG 约 3-3.5 配 30-50 步比 CFG 1 更连贯；25 步有条带状伪影，35-40 步消失。

phrases.en: The Turbo checkpoint's own 8-step schedule, CFG 1.
phrases.zh: Turbo 检查点自带的 8 步调度，CFG 1。

phrases.en: 3 = Fizgig's default for Qwen 2.1 previews (25 steps). 1 = no CFG (the reference default, twice as fast, flatter); much higher tends to oversaturate. Above 1 the negative prompt applies.
phrases.zh: 3 = Fizgig 对 Qwen 2.1 预览的默认（25 步）。1 = 无 CFG（官方默认，快一倍、更平淡）；再高容易过饱和。高于 1 时负面提示词生效。
✨ Qwen 2.1 快速（rank 8，自适应学习率）

phrases.en: ✨ Qwen 2.1 Fast Identity Mode (rank 8) - very close to full-model likeness, ~1.5x faster
phrases.zh: ✨ Qwen 2.1 快速身份模式（rank 8）—— 非常接近全模型相似度，快约 1.5 倍
✨ Qwen 2.1 标准（rank 16，自适应学习率）
✨ Qwen 2.1 编辑（rank 8，自适应学习率）

phrases.en: ✨ Qwen 2.1 Edit Strong (rank 16, adaptive LR) - trickier edits
phrases.zh: ✨ Qwen 2.1 强编辑（rank 16，自适应学习率）—— 更棘手的编辑

phrases.en: A plain LoRA is unstable: collapse to texture at lr 5e-4 (~step 300), wobble at 1e-4, a no-adapter Adaptive-LR run fell to 37 likeness at step 2000. Loss does not show it. Train with the frozen training adapter: 77.4 likeness (Fizgig adapter) vs 76.4 (SimpleTuner v2) vs 55.8 (none), and far better detail with Fizgig's (Peter's eye). Adaptive LR 1e-4..2e-4; ~2750 steps on a 170-image set.
phrases.zh: 普通 LoRA 不稳定：lr 5e-4 时崩塌为纹理（约 300 步），1e-4 时抖动，无适配器的自适应学习率运行在 2000 步时相似度跌到 37。损失看不出来。请配合冻结训练适配器训练：相似度 77.4（Fizgig 适配器）对 76.4（SimpleTuner v2）对 55.8（无），且 Fizgig 的细节好得多（Peter 目测）。自适应学习率 1e-4..2e-4；170 图集约 2750 步。

phrases.en: Text encoder conditioning is the LAST layer BEFORE the final RMSNorm, with a fixed system-prompt template whose tokens are dropped. transformers >= 5 returns the normed state unless hooked.
phrases.zh: 文本编码器条件化取最终 RMSNorm 之前的最后一层，配固定的系统提示模板且其 token 被丢弃。transformers >= 5 默认返回归一化后的状态，除非挂钩。

phrases.en: Block-causal attention (text causal, each image bidirectional) and t=0 modulation for the text prefix (causal_condition) are required in every training forward.
phrases.zh: 每次训练前向都需要块因果注意力（文本因果、每张图双向）与文本前缀的 t=0 调制（causal_condition）。

phrases.en: Gradient checkpointing with only block Linears LoRA-wrapped records no graph unless the joint hidden states require grad; layer offload produced NaN grads in ai-toolkit.
phrases.zh: 仅块 Linear 被 LoRA 包裹时，梯度检查点不记录图，除非联合隐状态需要梯度；层卸载在 ai-toolkit 中产生过 NaN 梯度。

phrases.en: Trains only the identity blocks (block_10-block_14): about 1.5x faster.
phrases.zh: 只训练身份块（block_10-block_14）：快约 1.5 倍。

phrases.en:
The pictures to bring into the edits: a person, an object, a place.
Name each after the photo it belongs to, adding _1, _2 ...: for beach.jpg, its extras are beach_1.jpg, beach_2.jpg.
The number is the order the model sees them in: beach_1 is the second picture after the original, beach_2 the third. Say so in the edit instruction, e.g. "Put the man from the second picture into this scene."
A photo can have none (it trains as a normal pair) or up to 9. Any shape or file type.
phrases.zh:
要带入编辑的图片：人物、物品、场景。
每张以所属照片命名并加 _1、_2 …：如 beach.jpg 的附加图是 beach_1.jpg、beach_2.jpg。
编号是模型看到它们的顺序：beach_1 是原图后的第二张，beach_2 是第三张。在编辑指令中说明这一点，例如“把第二张图里的男人放进这个场景。”
一张照片可以没有（按普通对训练）或最多 9 张。任意形状和文件类型。

phrases.en: 0 = off: full-quality previews (25 steps, CFG 3). 1 = on: the Turbo LoRA (8-step) renders previews in 8 steps, CFG 1, much faster but softer, so they undersell your LoRA. Steps and CFG switch with it. Previews only, never the saved LoRA. It works on previews of the training model only: untick "Use the Turbo model for samples" above to use it. Default 1.
phrases.zh: 0 = 关：全质量预览（25 步，CFG 3）。1 = 开：Turbo LoRA（8 步）以 8 步、CFG 1 渲染预览，快得多但更软，会低估你的 LoRA。步数和 CFG 随之切换。仅预览，从不进入保存的 LoRA。它只作用于训练模型的预览：取消勾选上方的“样本使用 Turbo 模型”即可使用。默认 1。

phrases.en: Set the Turbo LoRA (8-step) in Preferences for fast Turbo previews; without it previews use the plain model.
phrases.zh: 在偏好设置中配置 Turbo LoRA（8 步）以获得快速 Turbo 预览；未配置时预览用原模型。

phrases.en: 3 = Fizgig's default for Qwen 2.1 previews (25 steps). 1 = no CFG (the reference default, twice as fast, flatter); much higher tends to oversaturate. Above 1 the negative prompt applies. With the Turbo LoRA on (strength above 0), previews use CFG 1 and the box switches to it.
phrases.zh: 3 = Fizgig 对 Qwen 2.1 预览的默认（25 步）。1 = 无 CFG（官方默认，快一倍、更平淡）；再高容易过饱和。高于 1 时负面提示词生效。Turbo LoRA 开启（强度大于 0）时预览用 CFG 1，输入框随之切换。

phrases.en: Any SDXL checkpoint (.safetensors, the single file ComfyUI loads). Juggernaut XL is a strong photographic base; Illustrious, Pony, RealVis and other SDXL fine-tunes work the same way. Train on the checkpoint you will use the LoRA with.
phrases.zh: 任意 SDXL 检查点（.safetensors，ComfyUI 加载的单文件）。Juggernaut XL 是强大的摄影向基座；Illustrious、Pony、RealVis 及其他 SDXL 微调同样可用。请在你要搭配 LoRA 使用的检查点上训练。
~6.9 GB —— 动漫 / 插画基座

phrases.en: Leave empty to use the checkpoint's own VAE. Set it only to swap in a separate SDXL VAE.
phrases.zh: 留空使用检查点自带的 VAE。仅当要换用单独的 SDXL VAE 时才设置。

phrases.en: Leave empty: both CLIP text encoders are read from the checkpoint. Set it to another SDXL checkpoint to take its text encoders instead.
phrases.zh: 留空：两个 CLIP 文本编码器都从检查点读取。设为另一个 SDXL 检查点则改用其文本编码器。

phrases.en: sampler DPM++ 2M SDE, Karras schedule (in ComfyUI: dpmpp_2m_sde / karras)
phrases.zh: 采样器 DPM++ 2M SDE，Karras 调度（ComfyUI 中为 dpmpp_2m_sde / karras）

phrases.en: One SDXL checkpoint is all SDXL needs: its VAE and text encoders come from the same file.
phrases.zh: SDXL 只需一个检查点：其 VAE 和文本编码器都来自同一文件。

phrases.en: SDXL's attention modules under their block-weight names: input 4, 5, 7, 8, the middle block and output 0-5 (the resnets and the outer input / output blocks carry no attention and are not trained).
phrases.zh: SDXL 的注意力模块按块权重命名：input 4、5、7、8、中间块及 output 0-5（resnet 与外层输入 / 输出块无注意力、不训练）。

phrases.en: kohya keys on diffusers module names (lora_unet_down_blocks_1_attentions_0_...), which ComfyUI maps for SDXL. Community files in the LDM layout (lora_unet_input_blocks_4_1_...) load too (driver alias_flat); their text-encoder parts (lora_te1_ / lora_te2_) are not used.
phrases.zh: diffusers 模块名上的 kohya 键（lora_unet_down_blocks_1_attentions_0_...），ComfyUI 会为 SDXL 做映射。LDM 布局的社区文件（lora_unet_input_blocks_4_1_...）也能加载（驱动 alias_flat）；其文本编码器部分（lora_te1_ / lora_te2_）不使用。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) compiles SDXL's 70 transformer blocks when the run is long enough to repay the warm-up: measured about 1.4x faster on a 5090 (1.03 -> 0.75 s/step at 1 MP, with fused AdamW) and no extra memory. The first steps pause to compile (~25 s, then a few seconds for each new image shape). Auto waits for runs over about 200 steps; the INT8 and NF4 bases are not compiled by Auto (On still compiles). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) - both located automatically.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）在训练长到能回本时编译 SDXL 的 70 个 transformer 块：5090 上实测快约 1.4 倍（1 百万像素时 1.03 -> 0.75 秒/步，配融合 AdamW）且无额外显存。最初的步会暂停编译（约 25 秒，之后每个新图像形状几秒）。自动等待超过约 200 步的训练；INT8 和 NF4 基座不被自动编译（手动开启仍会编译）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。

phrases.en: DPM++ 2M SDE Karras, 30 steps, CFG 4-5, little or no negative: Fooocus's Juggernaut default and the Civitai card. CFG above 6-7 turns skin waxy.
phrases.zh: DPM++ 2M SDE Karras，30 步，CFG 4-5，负面提示词很少或不用：Fooocus 的 Juggernaut 默认及 Civitai 卡片。CFG 高于 6-7 会让皮肤蜡化。

phrases.en: Plain Euler, trailing spacing (starts at full noise): a softer look, less pore detail.
phrases.zh: 普通 Euler，trailing 间距（从全噪声开始）：观感更柔、毛孔细节更少。

phrases.en: SDXL needs CFG: 3 is the default, 3 to 5 the usual range (Juggernaut's skin turns waxy above 6-7). Above 1 the negative prompt applies.
phrases.zh: SDXL 需要 CFG：默认 3，常用 3 到 5（Juggernaut 的皮肤在 6-7 以上会蜡化）。高于 1 时负面提示词生效。

phrases.en: Captions and prompts longer than CLIP's 77 tokens are encoded in 77-token chunks side by side, as ComfyUI does, so nothing is cut off.
phrases.zh: 超过 CLIP 77 token 的标注和提示词会按 77 token 分块并排编码（与 ComfyUI 相同），不会被截断。

phrases.en: Training: DDPM epsilon prediction on SDXL's scaled-linear schedule (betas 0.00085-0.012, 1000 steps), uniform timesteps, unweighted MSE; size conditioning (time_ids) from the bucket size with no crop.
phrases.zh: 训练：在 SDXL 的缩放线性调度上做 DDPM epsilon 预测（betas 0.00085-0.012，1000 步），均匀时间步，无加权 MSE；尺寸条件（time_ids）取自分桶尺寸、无裁剪。

phrases.en: The VAE runs in fp32: SDXL's VAE overflows in half precision.
phrases.zh: VAE 以 fp32 运行：SDXL 的 VAE 在半精度下会溢出。

phrases.en: Evens out how much the noisiest and cleanest steps count. Common in other SDXL trainers; in Fizgig's A/B it gave no gain, so it starts off.
phrases.zh: 拉平最噪与最干净步数的权重。其他 SDXL 训练器常用；Fizgig 的 A/B 中无收益，因此默认关闭。

phrases.en: 0.0357 is the offset SDXL base was trained with; 0 (off) trained as well in Fizgig's A/B.
phrases.zh: 0.0357 是 SDXL 基座训练时用的偏移；Fizgig 的 A/B 中 0（关闭）训练效果同样好。

phrases.en: Anima Base v1.0 - the version LoRAs are trained on (the model card's advice). LoRAs trained on it also work on Anima Aesthetic and Turbo.
phrases.zh: Anima Base v1.0 —— 模型卡片建议 LoRA 训练所用的版本。在其上训练的 LoRA 也能用于 Anima Aesthetic 和 Turbo。

phrases.en: The Qwen-Image VAE - the same file Krea 2 uses.
phrases.zh: Qwen-Image VAE —— 与 Krea 2 用的是同一个文件。

phrases.en: Qwen3 0.6B base - used for caching, then unloaded before training.
phrases.zh: Qwen3 0.6B 基础版 —— 缓存时使用，训练前卸载。

phrases.en: Optional: fast previews (about 10 steps, no CFG).
phrases.zh: 可选：快速预览（约 10 步，无 CFG）。

phrases.en: 28 identical DiT blocks (self-attention, cross-attention to the text, MLP). The LLM adapter that turns the text into the DiT's context is never trained (the model card: it degrades easily).
phrases.zh: 28 个相同的 DiT 块（自注意力、对文本的交叉注意力、MLP）。把文本转成 DiT 上下文的 LLM 适配器从不训练（模型卡片：它容易退化）。

phrases.en: kohya keys, as sd-scripts writes Anima LoRAs; ComfyUI maps lora_unet_blocks_N_... to diffusion_model.blocks.N.... The official LoRAs' PEFT keys (diffusion_model.*.lora_A/B) load too.
phrases.zh: kohya 键，按 sd-scripts 写 Anima LoRA 的方式；ComfyUI 把 lora_unet_blocks_N_... 映射到 diffusion_model.blocks.N....。官方 LoRA 的 PEFT 键（diffusion_model.*.lora_A/B）也能加载。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) compiles Anima's 28 blocks when the run is long enough to repay the warm-up: measured about 2.3x faster on a 5090 (0.71 -> 0.31 s/step at 1 MP, with fused AdamW), about 0.4 GB more memory. The first steps pause to compile (~40 s, then a few seconds for each new image shape). Auto waits for runs over about 300 steps; the INT8 and NF4 bases are not compiled by Auto (On still compiles). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) - both located automatically.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）在训练长到能回本时编译 Anima 的 28 个块：5090 上实测快约 2.3 倍（1 百万像素时 0.71 -> 0.31 秒/步，配融合 AdamW），显存多约 0.4 GB。最初的步会暂停编译（约 40 秒，之后每个新图像形状几秒）。自动等待超过约 300 步的训练；INT8 和 NF4 基座不被自动编译（手动开启仍会编译）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。

phrases.en: Shift 3 (ComfyUI's default for Anima). Card: 30-50 steps, CFG 4-5, er_sde; the community finds 16-20 steps enough and settles on CFG 4.5.
phrases.zh: Shift 3（ComfyUI 对 Anima 的默认）。卡片：30-50 步，CFG 4-5，er_sde；社区发现 16-20 步就够，常用 CFG 4.5。

phrases.en: strength 0.4-0.6 at 12 steps with CFG 2-3.5 keeps the negative prompt
phrases.zh: 12 步配 CFG 2-3.5 时强度 0.4-0.6 可保留负面提示词

phrases.en: About 4.5 (below 2 washes out, above about 7 oversaturates). Anima reads danbooru tags or prose; the card's quality prefix is "masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe,".
phrases.zh: 约 4.5（低于 2 会寡淡，高于约 7 会过饱和）。Anima 可读 danbooru 标签或散文；卡片的质量前缀是“masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe,”。

phrases.en: Licence: CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License (and NVIDIA's Open Model License for the base). LoRAs are derivatives; generated images may be used commercially.
phrases.zh: 许可：CircleStone Labs 非商业许可（基座另受 NVIDIA 开放模型许可约束）。LoRA 属衍生品；生成图片可商用。

phrases.en: Do not train the LLM adapter - it degrades easily. Train on Base, not Turbo or Aesthetic.
phrases.zh: 不要训练 LLM 适配器 —— 它容易退化。在基础版上训练，而非 Turbo 或 Aesthetic。

phrases.en: Text: Qwen3 0.6B last hidden state on the raw caption plus the caption's T5 token ids through the adapter, padded to 512 tokens. Captions over 512 tokens are cut.
phrases.zh: 文本：Qwen3 0.6B 对原始标注取最后隐状态，加标注的 T5 token id 经适配器，填充到 512 token。超过 512 token 的标注被截断。

phrases.en: Training: rectified flow, logit-normal timesteps, unweighted MSE (diffusion-pipe, sd-scripts). noise_offset washes colours out; fp8 bases train badly.
phrases.zh: 训练：整流流、logit-normal 时间步、无加权 MSE（diffusion-pipe、sd-scripts）。noise_offset 会让颜色寡淡；fp8 基座训练效果差。

phrases.en: 0 = off: full-quality previews (20 steps, CFG 4.5). 1 = on: the Anima Turbo LoRA v0.2 renders previews in 10 steps, CFG 1, much faster but softer, so they undersell your LoRA. Steps and CFG switch with it. Previews only, never the saved LoRA. Default 1.
phrases.zh: 0 = 关：全质量预览（20 步，CFG 4.5）。1 = 开：Anima Turbo LoRA v0.2 以 10 步、CFG 1 渲染预览，快得多但更软，会低估你的 LoRA。步数和 CFG 随之切换。仅预览，从不进入保存的 LoRA。默认 1。

phrases.en: Set the Anima Turbo LoRA v0.2 in Preferences for fast Turbo previews; without it previews use the plain model.
phrases.zh: 在偏好设置中配置 Anima Turbo LoRA v0.2 以获得快速 Turbo 预览；未配置时预览用原模型。

phrases.en: About 4.5 (below 2 washes out, above about 7 oversaturates). Anima reads danbooru tags or prose; the card's quality prefix is "masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe,". With the Turbo LoRA on (strength above 0), previews use CFG 1 and the box switches to it.
phrases.zh: 约 4.5（低于 2 会寡淡，高于约 7 会过饱和）。Anima 可读 danbooru 标签或散文；卡片的质量前缀是“masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe,”。Turbo LoRA 开启（强度大于 0）时预览用 CFG 1，输入框随之切换。

phrases.en: Z-Image Turbo bf16 (ComfyUI's single file) - trained on and previewed with.
phrases.zh: Z-Image Turbo bf16（ComfyUI 单文件）—— 训练与预览均用它。

phrases.en: The FLUX.1 autoencoder (ae.safetensors). Not the FLUX.2 VAE Klein uses.
phrases.zh: FLUX.1 自编码器（ae.safetensors）。不是 Klein 用的 FLUX.2 VAE。

phrases.en: Used for caching only, then unloaded before training.
phrases.zh: 仅缓存时使用，训练前卸载。

phrases.en: Frozen during training, off in previews and saved LoRAs: keeps Turbo's 8-step look intact while the LoRA learns. Against the adapter most people use: better likeness, better image quality and better detail.
phrases.zh: 训练时冻结，预览和保存的 LoRA 中关闭：在 LoRA 学习的同时保持 Turbo 的 8 步观感。对比大多数人用的适配器：相似度、画质与细节都更好。

phrases.en: 30 identical single-stream layers (attention + SwiGLU MLP, per-layer AdaLN). The two noise and two context refiner layers ahead of them are not trained.
phrases.zh: 30 个相同的单流层（注意力 + SwiGLU MLP，逐层 AdaLN）。其前的两个噪声和两个上下文精炼层不训练。

phrases.en: Diffusers module names under diffusion_model., as AI-Toolkit writes Z-Image LoRAs; ComfyUI slices to_q / to_k / to_v onto its fused attention.qkv and maps to_out.0 to attention.out.
phrases.zh: diffusion_model. 下的 diffusers 模块名，按 AI-Toolkit 写 Z-Image LoRA 的方式；ComfyUI 把 to_q / to_k / to_v 切到融合的 attention.qkv 上，并把 to_out.0 映射到 attention.out。

phrases.en: Keeps Z-Image Turbo's 8-step look intact: frozen at 1.0 for every training step, off for previews and never in your saved file. Without it Turbo LoRAs go soft and painterly.
phrases.zh: 保持 Z-Image Turbo 的 8 步观感：每步训练固定 1.0，预览关闭，从不进入你保存的文件。没有它 Turbo LoRA 会变软、像手绘。

phrases.en: Auto (recommended) turns torch.compile on only when this run is long enough to repay it. On Z-Image Turbo it is measured 1.49x per step on the INT8 base (1.03 -> 0.69 s/step at 1 MP) and 1.18x on bf16 (0.92 -> 0.78), with almost no extra memory: the gradient checkpoint stays outside the compiled layers. The first epoch runs slower while the layers compile, so Auto waits for runs longer than about 300 steps on INT8 and 600 on bf16; NF4 is not compiled by Auto (On still compiles). Requires Triton and, on Windows, a C++ compiler (VS Build Tools) - both located automatically. Never used with Blocks Swap, since swapping moves weights and compiled graphs assume they stay put.
phrases.zh: 自动（推荐）仅在本轮训练长到能回本时才开启 torch.compile。在 Z-Image Turbo 上实测：INT8 基座每步 1.49 倍（1 百万像素时 1.03 -> 0.69 秒/步），bf16 上 1.18 倍（0.92 -> 0.78），几乎无额外显存：梯度检查点在编译层之外。第一个 epoch 因层编译而较慢，所以自动模式会等训练超过约 300 步（INT8）或 600 步（bf16）；NF4 不被自动编译（手动开启仍会编译）。需要 Triton，Windows 上还需要 C++ 编译器（VS Build Tools）—— 都会自动定位。从不与块交换同时使用，因为交换会移动权重，而编译图假定它们不动。

phrases.en: 8 steps, no CFG, shift 3 (the reference: 9 scheduler steps whose last is skipped).
phrases.zh: 8 步，无 CFG，shift 3（官方参考：调度器 9 步、跳过最后一步）。
✨ Z-Image Turbo 快速（rank 8，自适应学习率）
✨ Z-Image Turbo 标准（rank 16，自适应学习率）

phrases.en: Train on Turbo with the training adapter active (AI-Toolkit's recipe); a LoRA trained without it breaks the distillation and renders soft at 8 steps.
phrases.zh: 在 Turbo 上配合训练适配器训练（AI-Toolkit 的配方）；不这样训的 LoRA 会破坏蒸馏、8 步渲染发软。

phrases.en: Text: Qwen3-4B, the chat template with thinking on and the generation prompt, hidden_states[-2], real tokens only, at most 512.
phrases.zh: 文本：Qwen3-4B，开启思考的对话模板加生成提示，hidden_states[-2]，仅真实 token，至多 512。

phrases.en: The XL Turbo model (8 steps): what LoRAs train on by default, and what the workbench and previews render with.
phrases.zh: XL Turbo 模型（8 步）：LoRA 默认训练所用的模型，也是工作台和预览渲染所用的模型。

phrases.en: Optional: the non-distilled XL model, for the SFT Training Base (30-step previews with guidance - slower, the most detail).
phrases.zh: 可选：非蒸馏的 XL 模型，用于 SFT 训练基座（带引导的 30 步预览 —— 更慢、细节最多）。

phrases.en: The Oobleck audio VAE: 48 kHz stereo to 64 channels at 25 per second.
phrases.zh: Oobleck 音频 VAE：48 kHz 立体声编码为每秒 25 帧的 64 通道。

phrases.en: Optional: ACE-Step XL Turbo's own weights as a LoRA. In Repair Studio its block sliders become an EQ of the model itself - 1.0 is the stock model - and a save bakes your EQ into an ordinary LoRA. Load it as the primary or the donor with the Model EQ buttons.
phrases.zh: 可选：把 ACE-Step XL Turbo 自身的权重做成 LoRA。在修复工作室里它的块滑杆就成了模型自身的均衡器 —— 1.0 即原版模型 —— 保存时会把你的 EQ 烤进一个普通 LoRA。用 Model EQ 按钮把它作为主 LoRA 或 donor 加载。

phrases.en: Encodes the captions and lyrics for caching, then unloads before training.
phrases.zh: 为缓存编码标注和歌词，训练前卸载。

phrases.en: Each sample prompt is a song: "caption | lyrics", lyric lines separated by " / " (e.g. "[verse] / first line / second line"). Leave out the lyrics for an instrumental. Songs train for hundreds of epochs, so a preview every 25-50 epochs is plenty.
phrases.zh: 每条样本提示词是一首歌：“标注 | 歌词”，歌词行用“ / ”分隔（如“[verse] / 第一行 / 第二行”）。纯音乐可省略歌词。歌曲要训几百个 epoch，每 25-50 个 epoch 预览一次足矣。

phrases.en: 32 DiT layers, sliding-window (even) and full (odd) self-attention, each with cross-attention to the caption, lyrics and timbre. The LoRA wraps q/k/v/o of both attentions (the official trainer's targets).
phrases.zh: 32 层 DiT，滑动窗（偶数层）与全量（奇数层）自注意力，各带对标注、歌词与音色的交叉注意力。LoRA 包裹两种注意力的 q/k/v/o（官方训练器的目标）。

phrases.en: PEFT keys on the decoder (the official trainer's LoRA files), plus .alpha; ComfyUI maps base_model.model.<path> to diffusion_model.decoder.<path>. LoKR loads under the same names.
phrases.zh: 解码器上的 PEFT 键（官方训练器的 LoRA 文件），外加 .alpha；ComfyUI 把 base_model.model.<path> 映射到 diffusion_model.decoder.<path>。LoKR 以同名加载。

phrases.en: After hundreds of epochs the LoRA has learned the fine detail of your songs, and at strength 1 it can start copying them: the same song on every seed. Try the final LoRA at a lower strength, around 0.5 - you keep the learned detail without the copying.
phrases.zh: 几百个 epoch 后 LoRA 已学会你歌曲的细节，强度 1 时可能开始复制它们：每个种子都是同一首歌。试试最终 LoRA 用更低的强度，约 0.5 —— 保留学到的细节、不复制。

phrases.en: Saves and previews the running average of the LoRA instead of its latest step. A song set gives few steps an epoch (10 songs at accumulation 4 is about 3), so on a short run 0.98 averages over most of it and lags behind; Short run sizes the window to a quarter of the run. Long runs suit 0.98.
phrases.zh: 保存并预览 LoRA 的滑动平均而非最新一步。歌曲数据集每 epoch 步数很少（10 首歌、累积 4 时约 3 步），短训练里 0.98 会平均掉大部分而滞后；“短训练”把窗口定为训练的四分之一。长训练适合 0.98。

phrases.en: A normal LoRA: a sound, a genre or an artist's style, learned from your captioned songs.
phrases.zh: 普通 LoRA：一种声音、一个流派或一位艺术家的风格，从你写好标注的歌曲中学得。

phrases.en: Slider (a dial between two music styles)
phrases.zh: 滑杆（两种音乐风格之间的转盘）

phrases.en: A dial: at strength +1 the LoRA moves a song toward one style, at -1 toward the other, and anything in between. Previews play -1, 0 and +1 one after another.
phrases.zh: 一个转盘：强度 +1 时 LoRA 把歌曲推向一种风格，-1 时推向另一种，之间任意取值。预览会依次播放 -1、0 和 +1。

phrases.en: The whole model learns your songs, not a LoRA on top of it. Each checkpoint is a full model file (about 10 GB), loaded in place of the base.
phrases.zh: 整个模型学习你的歌曲，而非其上的 LoRA。每个检查点是完整的模型文件（约 10 GB），代替基座加载。

phrases.en: The start of the caption, e.g. "instrumental, synth pop," - each end's words are added after it with a space, so end it with a comma. Keep it general and the dial works on any song of that kind.
phrases.zh: 标注的开头，如“instrumental, synth pop,” —— 每端的词会在其后以空格接上，所以请以逗号结尾。保持泛化，转盘就能用于该类型的任何歌曲。
如“energetic, fast tempo, loud drums（活力、快节奏、响亮鼓点）”。

phrases.en: e.g. "calm, slow tempo, soft". Change one thing: words that also change the genre or the instruments turn the dial into a genre switch.
phrases.zh: 如“calm, slow tempo, soft（平静、慢节奏、轻柔）”。只改一件事：若词同时改变流派或乐器，转盘就成了流派开关。

phrases.en: Captions of music the dial must not change, one a line. For a heavier-guitar dial meant for rock, "instrumental, solo piano, classical" keeps piano pieces as they are; for an energy dial, "ambient, soft pads, no drums" keeps ambient tracks calm. Each step checks one of them in turn, and the previews play the first one beside the dial, so you can hear it stay put. Each one makes a step about half as long again. Empty = none.
phrases.zh: 转盘不得改变的音乐标注，一行一条。以面向摇滚的重吉他转盘为例，“instrumental, solo piano, classical”让钢琴曲保持原样；以能量转盘为例，“ambient, soft pads, no drums”让氛围乐保持平静。每步轮流检查其中一条，预览会把第一条播在转盘旁，你可以听到它纹丝不动。每条会让一步长约增加一半。留空 = 无。

phrases.en: The official Turbo schedule (shift 3, 8 steps), no CFG.
phrases.zh: 官方 Turbo 调度（shift 3，8 步），无 CFG。

phrases.en: Licence: MIT (code and weights); generated music may be used commercially.
phrases.zh: 许可：MIT（代码与权重）；生成的音乐可商用。

phrases.en: A training song is an audio file with a caption .txt; its lyrics go in <name>.lyrics.txt (none = instrumental) and bpm / timesignature / keyscale / language in an optional <name>.json. Songs over 240 s are cut to the first 240 s (the official trainer's max_duration).
phrases.zh: 一首训练歌曲是一个音频文件加一个标注 .txt；歌词放在 <name>.lyrics.txt（没有 = 纯音乐），bpm / timesignature / keyscale / language 放在可选的 <name>.json。超过 240 秒的歌曲剪到前 240 秒（官方训练器的 max_duration）。

phrases.en: Conditioning follows the official handler's text-to-music: the 'Fill the audio semantic mask' prompt with the metadata block, lyrics as '# Languages / # Lyric' token embeddings, the silence latent as context and as the 30 s timbre reference. The official trainer feeds lyrics raw and a zero timbre reference; Fizgig trains the way the model is prompted.
phrases.zh: 条件化遵循官方处理器的文生乐：带元数据块的“Fill the audio semantic mask”提示，歌词作为“# Languages / # Lyric”token 嵌入，静音潜变量作为上下文和 30 秒音色参考。官方训练器喂原始歌词和零音色参考；Fizgig 按模型被提示的方式训练。

phrases.en: XL's timbre encoder reads a learned CLS token placed before the reference frames (the XL code); ComfyUI reads the first frame without it, which moves the velocity ~2% with the silence reference (measured). Fizgig follows the official XL code.
phrases.zh: XL 的音色编码器读取置于参考帧之前的学习型 CLS token（XL 代码）；ComfyUI 不带它读第一帧，在静音参考下速度会偏约 2%（实测）。Fizgig 遵循官方 XL 代码。

phrases.en: Turbo trains on its own 8 timesteps (shift 3) with no CFG dropout, as the official trainer does. SFT trains with continuous logit-normal timesteps (mu -0.4, sigma 1) and 15% null-condition dropout (Side-Step's corrected mode) and previews with 30 steps, shift 1, APG guidance 7 (the XL SFT code's defaults).
phrases.zh: Turbo 按官方训练器在自身 8 个时间步（shift 3）上训练、无 CFG 丢弃。SFT 用连续 logit-normal 时间步（mu -0.4，sigma 1）和 15% 空条件丢弃（Side-Step 的修正模式）训练，预览用 30 步、shift 1、APG 引导 7（XL SFT 代码的默认值）。

phrases.en: Turbo is what most people generate with. SFT is the non-distilled model: its previews take 30 guided steps (slower) and it needs the SFT DiT in Preferences.
phrases.zh: Turbo 是大多数人用来生成的模型。SFT 是非蒸馏模型：其预览需 30 个带引导的步（更慢），且需要在偏好设置中配置 SFT DiT。

phrases.en: How long each preview song is.
These settings are read when a run starts. A paused run resumes with its own settings; a dataset or caption change needs a fresh run.
phrases.zh: 这些设置在训练开始时读取。暂停的运行以其自身设置恢复；数据集或标注变化需要新一轮训练。

phrases.en: Each preview is rendered again at that strength (same prompt and seed), beside the full-strength one: how the LoRA will look or sound the way you'll use it.
phrases.zh: 每张预览按该强度再渲染一次（同提示词同种子），摆在全强度旁边：即你日常使用时 LoRA 的观感或听感。
Flux 3 Image Klein 基础 DiT

phrases.en: bf16 Base (undistilled) for training. Files with _sd_ in the name are the distilled model.
phrases.zh: 用于训练的 bf16 基础版（未蒸馏）。文件名带 _sd_ 的是蒸馏模型。
FLUX.2 自编码器，与 Klein 9B 的相同。

phrases.en: Used for caching only, then unloaded.
phrases.zh: 仅缓存时使用，随后卸载。

phrases.en: 16 steps, no CFG: fast previews and the workbench.
phrases.zh: 16 步，无 CFG：快速预览与工作台。

phrases.en: Five blocks each for the image, the reference images and the text run before the streams meet, then 28 shared single blocks. Reference blocks only run on edits.
phrases.zh: 图像、参考图和文本各有五个块先运行，之后合流进 28 个共享单块。参考块只在编辑时运行。

phrases.en: kohya keys over the reference module names; ComfyUI maps lora_unet_<path>_q_proj / _k_proj / _v_proj onto thirds of its fused qkv.
phrases.zh: 参考模块名上的 kohya 键；ComfyUI 把 lora_unet_<path>_q_proj / _k_proj / _v_proj 映射到融合 qkv 的三份。

phrases.en: Flow map: each step jumps to the next time, no CFG.
phrases.zh: 流图：每步跳到下一个时间，无 CFG。

phrases.en: Use the distilled model for samples (16 steps, no CFG - quick)
phrases.zh: 样本使用蒸馏模型（16 步，无 CFG —— 快）

phrases.en: Base samples only - the distilled samples use their own 16 steps
phrases.zh: 仅基础模型样本 —— 蒸馏样本用它自己的 16 步

phrases.en: Undistilled: Euler, shifted schedule alpha 6.93, CFG against the empty prompt.
phrases.zh: 未蒸馏：Euler，shift 调度 alpha 6.93，对空提示词做 CFG。
✨ Flux 3 极速（rank 16，自适应学习率）
✨ Flux 3 编辑（rank 16，自适应学习率）
✨ Flux 3 强编辑（rank 32）—— 更棘手的编辑

phrases.en: Text conditioning keeps the padding: prompts are padded to a multiple of 80 tokens and the DiT attends every token, so the cache stores the padded sequence.
phrases.zh: 文本条件化保留填充：提示词填充到 80 token 的倍数且 DiT 关注每个 token，因此缓存存的是填充后的序列。

phrases.en: Training timestep distribution is not published; the driver samples logit-normal shifted by the sampler's alpha 6.93 until measured otherwise.
phrases.zh: 训练时间步分布未公开；驱动按采样器的 alpha 6.93 做 logit-normal 偏移采样，直到有实测结论。

phrases.en: bf16 Base for training (the model card: Base is for fine-tuning and LoRAs). The SFT file (moss_image_sft_bf16) is for use, not training.
phrases.zh: 用于训练的 bf16 基础版（模型卡片：基础版用于微调和 LoRA）。SFT 文件（moss_image_sft_bf16）是使用版、非训练版。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image Base - ComfyUI's single file. The official diffusers shards (OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base transformer/) and the int8_convrot file load too. (Kromoss is not recommended to train on: in our test a LoRA on it began to overbake after about 750 steps.)
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image 基础版 —— ComfyUI 单文件。官方 diffusers 分片（OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base transformer/）和 int8_convrot 文件也能加载。（不建议在 Kromoss 上训练：我们的测试中其上的 LoRA 约 750 步后开始过火。）
FLUX.2 自编码器（小解码器）

phrases.en: The FLUX.2 autoencoder with BFL's small decoder, the decoder MOSS-Image ships with.
phrases.zh: 带 BFL 小解码器的 FLUX.2 自编码器，即 MOSS-Image 出厂配的解码器。

phrases.en: FLUX.2's encoder with the small decoder MOSS-Image was released with. Flux 3's or Klein's full autoencoder also works (same latents), but the small decoder avoids spots in the pictures.
phrases.zh: FLUX.2 的编码器配 MOSS-Image 发布时的小解码器。Flux 3 或 Klein 的完整自编码器也可用（潜变量相同），但小解码器可避免图片中的斑点。

phrases.en: Optional speed LoRA for previews; leave empty to preview at full quality.
phrases.zh: 可选的预览加速 LoRA；留空则全质量预览。

phrases.en: Optional. lodestones' 8-step Turbo LoRA, distilled from MOSS-Image Base: fast previews on your Base (untick the SFT samples tick; previews on SFT never take a Turbo LoRA). Leave it empty for full-quality previews. With one set, set its strength, steps and CFG on the Samples tab; the workbench follows.
phrases.zh: 可选。lodestones 的 8 步 Turbo LoRA，从 MOSS-Image 基础版蒸馏：在你的基础版上快速预览（取消 SFT 样本勾选；SFT 上的预览从不配 Turbo LoRA）。留空则全质量预览。设置后，其强度、步数和 CFG 在“样本”标签页调整；工作台跟随。

phrases.en: Used for caching only, then unloaded. Loads text-only (about 15 GB), or 8-bit (about 9 GB) on smaller cards.
phrases.zh: 仅缓存时使用，随后卸载。可纯文本加载（约 15 GB），较小显卡可用 8 位（约 9 GB）。

phrases.en: ~9.7 GB int8 ConvRot, the file ComfyUI's MOSS-Image workflow uses; decoded at load
phrases.zh: ~9.7 GB int8 ConvRot，ComfyUI 的 MOSS-Image 工作流所用的文件；加载时解码

phrases.en: OpenMOSS's everyday checkpoint: training samples, Repair Studio and LoRA Royale render your LoRA on it (untick it on the Samples tab for samples on the Base), showing the LoRA where most people use it. Never trained. ComfyUI's int8 ConvRot file is decoded at load; the bf16 SFT file works as well.
phrases.zh: OpenMOSS 的日常检查点：训练样本、修复工作室和 LoRA 竞技场把你的 LoRA 渲染在它上（在“样本”标签页取消勾选则用基础版出样本），展示 LoRA 在大多数人使用处的样子。从不参与训练。ComfyUI 的 int8 ConvRot 文件加载时解码；bf16 SFT 文件也可用。

phrases.en: Optional. Fizgig's SFT look LoRA: previews on your Base get much of SFT's look without loading SFT, so they're much quicker. Downloaded for you the first time you tick "Give Base previews the SFT look" on the Samples tab. Previews only, never training.
phrases.zh: 可选。Fizgig 的 SFT 外观 LoRA：基础版上的预览无需加载 SFT 即获得其大部分观感，因此快得多。首次在“样本”标签页勾选“给基础版预览 SFT 外观”时自动下载。仅预览，从不参与训练。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image support is new and improving daily: update Fizgig regularly to get the latest fixes.
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image 支持尚新、每天都在改进：请定期更新 Fizgig 以获得最新修复。

phrases.en: res_multistep on MOSS-Image's shift-5 schedule (in ComfyUI: res_multistep, simple scheduler), block 22 skipped in the negative branch.
phrases.zh: 在 MOSS-Image 的 shift-5 调度上用 res_multistep（ComfyUI 中为 res_multistep、simple 调度器），负面分支跳过块 22。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image doesn't respond well to short one-line prompts, and they can make the previews look worse. Describe the picture in a few sentences: framing, light, background and detail.
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image 对单行短提示词反应不佳，且可能让预览变差。请用几句话描述画面：取景、光线、背景与细节。

phrases.en: 42 joint blocks with one shared modulation (so per-block sliders act on attention and MLP), after a two-block text adapter that refines the Qwen3.5 states before they meet the image.
phrases.zh: 42 个联合块共享一个调制（因此逐块滑杆只作用于注意力和 MLP），其前是一个两块的文本适配器，在与图像相遇前精炼 Qwen3.5 状态。

phrases.en: kohya keys over the reference module names. ComfyUI's MOSSImage branch maps lora_unet_layers_N_proj_q / _k / _v onto thirds of the fused proj.qkv in Comfy-Org's file; its generic map takes the same keys on an unfused model (the OpenMOSS ComfyUI plugin). LoKR saves as diffusion_model.layers.N.proj.q, which both maps also take.
phrases.zh: 参考模块名上的 kohya 键。ComfyUI 的 MOSSImage 分支把 lora_unet_layers_N_proj_q / _k / _v 映射到 Comfy-Org 文件中融合 proj.qkv 的三份；其通用映射在未融合模型上取同名键（OpenMOSS ComfyUI 插件）。LoKR 存为 diffusion_model.layers.N.proj.q，两种映射都认。

phrases.en: The Base samples' sampler (ComfyUI's res_multistep / simple 30, CFG 4, shift 5, SLG block 22 for the first half) on the SFT checkpoint.
phrases.zh: 基础版样本的采样器（ComfyUI 的 res_multistep / simple 30，CFG 4，shift 5，前半程 SLG 块 22）用在 SFT 检查点上。

phrases.en: a small dataset. With {n} images, MOSS-Image can take longer to converge than other models, so allow more epochs before judging it.
phrases.zh: 一个小数据集。{n} 张图时，MOSS-Image 的收敛可能比其他模型慢，评判前多给几个 epoch。

phrases.en: Give Base previews the SFT look (SFT look LoRA)
phrases.zh: 给基础版预览 SFT 外观（SFT 外观 LoRA）

phrases.en: For previews on your Base (the SFT tick above off): the SFT look LoRA gives them much of SFT's look. Not as good as SFT itself, but a really good indicator, and previews are much quicker with no model swap. Previews only, never training. Downloaded for you the first time (about 2.1 GB).
phrases.zh: 用于基础版上的预览（上方 SFT 勾选关闭时）：SFT 外观 LoRA 给它们 SFT 的大部分观感。不如 SFT 本身，但已是很好的参考指标，且无需换模型、预览快得多。仅预览，从不参与训练。首次自动下载（约 2.1 GB）。

phrases.en: We still recommend not using the Turbo LoRA for previews.
phrases.zh: 我们仍建议预览不要用 Turbo LoRA。
在 MOSS-Image SFT 上预览。

phrases.en: Previewed on the Base with the SFT look LoRA. For maximum quality, look at it in ComfyUI.
phrases.zh: 在基础版上配 SFT 外观 LoRA 预览。要最高画质请在 ComfyUI 里查看。

phrases.en: Previewed on the Base model. For a better read of quality, tick Give Base previews the SFT look, or preview on SFT (slower).
phrases.zh: 在基础模型上预览。要更准确的质量判断，勾选“给基础版预览 SFT 外观”，或在 SFT 上预览（较慢）。

phrases.en: ⚡ Turbo LoRA in use: not full quality. We recommend leaving it off.
phrases.zh: ⚡ 正在使用 Turbo LoRA：非全质量。我们建议关闭它。

phrases.en: Use the SFT model for samples (set it in Preferences)
phrases.zh: 样本使用 SFT 模型（在偏好设置中配置）

phrases.en: Base samples only - the SFT samples use their own 30 steps, CFG 4
phrases.zh: 仅基础模型样本 —— SFT 样本用它自己的 30 步、CFG 4

phrases.en: As ComfyUI renders it: res_multistep on ComfyUI's simple schedule (shift 5), CFG 4, and the SLG switch on (SkipLayerGuidanceDiTSimple: block 22 skipped in the negative branch for the first half, sigma >= 0.83).
phrases.zh: 与 ComfyUI 渲染方式相同：ComfyUI simple 调度上的 res_multistep（shift 5），CFG 4，SLG 开启（SkipLayerGuidanceDiTSimple：前半程负面分支跳过块 22，sigma >= 0.83）。

phrases.en: AI Toolkit's MOSS-Image sample settings: the reference sampler at 30 steps.
phrases.zh: AI Toolkit 的 MOSS-Image 采样设置：参考采样器 30 步。

phrases.en: Flow-matching Euler on the shift-5 grid snapped to the 1000 training sigmas; CFG 3 with block 22 skipped in the negative branch; the negative is empty by default.
phrases.zh: 在 shift-5 网格上的流匹配 Euler、对齐 1000 个训练 sigma；CFG 3、负面分支跳过块 22；负面提示词默认为空。

phrases.en: SkipLayerGuidanceDiTSimple layer 22 on the negative, and no ModelSamplingSD3 node: ComfyUI's MOSS-Image model brings its own sampling, and adding one renders badly (Peter, 18 Oct 2026). ComfyUI's scheduler does not snap to the training grid, so the same seed differs slightly.
phrases.zh: 负面分支用 SkipLayerGuidanceDiTSimple 第 22 层，且不要 ModelSamplingSD3 节点：ComfyUI 的 MOSS-Image 模型自带采样，再加节点会渲染得很糟（Peter，2026 年 10 月 18 日）。ComfyUI 的调度器不对齐训练网格，因此同一种子会有细微差异。

phrases.en: 12 steps, no CFG, the reference's shift-5 grid.
phrases.zh: 12 步，无 CFG，参考版的 shift-5 网格。

phrases.en: Distilled from MOSS-Image Base (Kromoss card: Base 27.19 -> 27.53 CLIP with it, Kromoss 27.82).
phrases.zh: 从 MOSS-Image 基础版蒸馏（Kromoss 卡片：基础版配它 27.19 -> 27.53 CLIP，Kromoss 27.82）。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image Turbo LoRAs aren't mature yet: they can reduce likeness a lot in previews, so judge likeness on full-quality previews.
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image 的 Turbo LoRA 尚未成熟：可能在预览中大幅降低相似度，请在全质量预览上评判相似度。

phrases.en: 4 = Fizgig's default (MOSS-Image's guide: 3-6; raise it for short prompts). The negative branch skips block 22, as the reference does. 1 = no CFG.
phrases.zh: 4 = Fizgig 默认（MOSS-Image 指南：3-6；短提示词可调高）。负面分支跳过块 22，与参考一致。1 = 无 CFG。
✨ MOSS-Image 快速（rank 16，0.25 百万像素）

phrases.en: Training timesteps follow the released weights' last pretraining interval: sigma = 1 - sigmoid(Z), Z ~ N(-1.09, 0.95^2), truncated at 0.95 and rescaled onto the 1000-step grid, mixed with 1% uniform (Fizgig's Clean-end share moves the curve's centre: by default 60% of steps below sigma 0.5 until epoch 7, then down to 30% by epoch 15, and every 2nd epoch after that at 60%; the reference is about 11%); the DiT is told 1000 * sigma; loss is the unweighted per-token MSE on noise - x0.
phrases.zh: 训练时间步遵循已发布权重最后一个预训练区间：sigma = 1 - sigmoid(Z)，Z ~ N(-1.09, 0.95^2)，在 0.95 处截断并重标到 1000 步网格，混入 1% 均匀分布（Fizgig 的“干净端占比”移动曲线中心：默认到 epoch 7 为止 60% 的步低于 sigma 0.5，随后到 epoch 15 降至 30%，之后每 2 个 epoch 回到 60%；参考版约 11%）；DiT 得到 1000 * sigma；损失是对噪声 - x0 的逐 token 无加权 MSE。

phrases.en: Text conditioning: Qwen3.5-9B's final hidden state through the chat template with an open <|block|>, unpadded, up to 4096 tokens. Keep the text encoder frozen.
phrases.zh: 文本条件化：Qwen3.5-9B 经对话模板的最终隐状态，带未闭合的 <|block|>、不填充、至多 4096 token。保持文本编码器冻结。

phrases.en: No edit or reference-image training: the released checkpoints are text-to-image only. 'Layout editing' means regenerating from an edited layout prompt, not conditioning on a picture.
phrases.zh: 无编辑或参考图训练：已发布的检查点仅文生图。“布局编辑”指从编辑过的布局提示词重新生成，而非以图片为条件。

phrases.en: No speed LoRA or distilled checkpoint yet (DMD distillation is announced as coming), so previews run the full 50 steps with CFG.
phrases.zh: 尚无加速 LoRA 或蒸馏检查点（DMD 蒸馏已宣布在途），因此预览跑完整的 50 步带 CFG。

phrases.en: A LoRA or a fine-tune trains only attention (q, k, v, o), not the feed-forward layers. Recommended on MOSS-Image SFT or a fine-tune of it, where training the feed-forward layers breaks anatomy. Uses less VRAM, so a fine-tune fits a smaller card, but on Base it may cost quality or slow convergence.
phrases.zh: LoRA 或微调只训练注意力（q、k、v、o），不训前馈层。在 MOSS-Image SFT 或其微调上推荐开启 —— 那里训前馈层会破坏人体结构。显存占用更少、微调可进更小的卡，但在基础版上可能损失质量或减慢收敛。

phrases.en: The share of training steps on nearly-clean images (noise below half), where faces and fine detail are refined. Empty = the model's own schedule, about 11%.
phrases.zh: 近干净图片（噪声低于一半）上的训练步占比，人脸与细节在此精修。留空 = 模型自身调度，约 11%。

phrases.en: Slide: a high share until an epoch, then easing down to a lower one, a few points an epoch. 60 until epoch 7, down to 30 by epoch 15, works well with datasets of up to about 55 images; with many more, start dropping below 60 earlier. Ticked: after the slide, every few epochs one epoch goes back to the first share, which keeps likeness from fading on a small dataset at the lower share.
phrases.zh: 滑降：高占比到某个 epoch，再缓降到较低值、每个 epoch 降几个点。60 到 epoch 7、到 epoch 15 降到 30，对约 55 张以内的数据集效果良好；更多图则更早开始降到 60 以下。勾选后：滑降完成后每隔几个 epoch 有一个 epoch 回到初始占比，防止小数据集在低占比下相似度消退。

phrases.en: 0 = off: full-quality previews (30 steps, CFG 4). 1 = on: the MOSS-Image Turbo LoRA renders previews in 12 steps, CFG 1, much faster but softer, so they undersell your LoRA. Steps and CFG switch with it. Previews only, never the saved LoRA. It works on previews of the training model only: untick "Use the SFT model for samples" above to use it.
phrases.zh: 0 = 关：全质量预览（30 步，CFG 4）。1 = 开：MOSS-Image Turbo LoRA 以 12 步、CFG 1 渲染预览，快得多但更软，会低估你的 LoRA。步数和 CFG 随之切换。仅预览，从不进入保存的 LoRA。它只作用于训练模型的预览：取消勾选上方的“样本使用 SFT 模型”即可使用。

phrases.en: Set the MOSS-Image Turbo LoRA in Preferences for fast Turbo previews; without it previews use the plain model.
phrases.zh: 在偏好设置中配置 MOSS-Image Turbo LoRA 以获得快速 Turbo 预览；未配置时预览用原模型。

phrases.en: 4 = Fizgig's default (MOSS-Image's guide: 3-6; raise it for short prompts). The negative branch skips block 22, as the reference does. 1 = no CFG. With the Turbo LoRA on (strength above 0), previews use CFG 1 and the box switches to it.
phrases.zh: 4 = Fizgig 默认（MOSS-Image 指南：3-6；短提示词可调高）。负面分支跳过块 22，与参考一致。1 = 无 CFG。Turbo LoRA 开启（强度大于 0）时预览用 CFG 1，输入框随之切换。
用 SAM 3.1 从词语生成蒙版

phrases.en:
Make masks of anything by naming it: on the Image Prep tab's masks card, choose SAM 3.1 and type what the masks show (person, hair, the dog) and what to leave out (glasses). Meta's Segment Anything finds it, with much sharper edges than the person finder.

Download it once from the card (1.75 GB), preview it on two random pictures, then make masks.
phrases.zh:
点名即可给任何东西做蒙版：在图像预处理标签页的蒙版卡片上选择 SAM 3.1，输入蒙版要显示的（人物、头发、狗）和要排除的（眼镜）。Meta 的 Segment Anything 会找到它，边缘比人物查找器锐利得多。

从卡片下载一次（1.75 GB），在两张随机图片上预览，然后开始做蒙版。

phrases.en:
Train on the part of each picture that matters: the person, not the room around them. A black-and-white mask beside a picture says which part counts; the picture still trains whole, so the LoRA sees your subject in their scene but stops copying the scene. In our tests of character LoRAs, masks significantly raised both the best likeness a run reached, by eye and in likeness scores, and how quickly it got there, on every recent model. It seems especially effective on MOSS-Image with its default Clean-end share, Slide.

Tick it on the Training tab (Masked training card), and make masks for a whole folder on the Image Prep tab, or paint your own. Since 8.9.7 it also has prior preservation outside the mask, so backgrounds and the model's look stay the model's own.
phrases.zh:
只训练每张图中重要的部分：人，而非其周围的房间。图片旁的黑白蒙版指明哪部分重要；图片仍整体参与训练，LoRA 看得到主体所处的场景、但不再复制场景。在我们对角色 LoRA 的测试中，蒙版在所有近期模型上都显著提升了运行能达到的最佳相似度（目测与评分皆是）以及达到速度。在默认干净端占比为滑降的 MOSS-Image 上似乎尤其有效。

在训练标签页勾选（蒙版训练卡片），并在图像预处理标签页为整个文件夹做蒙版，或自己绘制。8.9.7 起还支持蒙版外先验保留，背景和模型风格保持模型自己的。
40 GB 以上显卡训练提速

phrases.en:
On cards with 40 GB or more, which is most pods (A100, A40, A6000, L40S, H100, RTX PRO 6000), Auto now turns gradient checkpointing off when the run fits with room to spare: 13-27 % faster per step on Krea 2, Qwen Image 2.1, MOSS-Image, Z-Image and MiniMax H3. Where it doesn't all fit, the last blocks go without it: 2-21 % faster.

Previews keep at least 4 GB free either way, and cards of 32 GB and under train as before. Restart your pods to get it.
phrases.zh:
40 GB 或以上的显卡（多数 pod：A100、A40、A6000、L40S、H100、RTX PRO 6000）上，自动模式现在在训练装得下且有余量时关闭梯度检查点：Krea 2、Qwen Image 2.1、MOSS-Image、Z-Image 和 MiniMax H3 每步快 13-27%。装不下时，最后的块不带它：快 2-21%。

两种情况下预览都保留至少 4 GB 空闲；32 GB 及以下的显卡训练照旧。重启 pod 即可获得。

phrases.en: Your other GPUs, at home or in the cloud, speeding up your run
phrases.zh: 你的其他 GPU，家中或云端，为训练提速

phrases.en:
A helper is another computer running Fizgig: a second PC or laptop, a second GPU in this computer, or a RunPod or Vast.ai pod. Add one on the Helpers tab, and it renders your previews so training never stops for them, takes over a run while you need your computer (Move to... on the run card), or trains a share of each epoch alongside your GPU.

In a share, each GPU trains its own copy of the LoRA on its part of the images, and the copies' changes are added into one LoRA at every combine: in testing its likeness matched a one-GPU run. On a fast network, combine every epoch for the closest result. It pays most on long runs. Training on a pod? Your home GPU can help it, and its checkpoints come home as they're saved.
phrases.zh:
辅助机是另一台运行 Fizgig 的电脑：第二台 PC 或笔记本、本机的第二块 GPU，或 RunPod / Vast.ai 的 pod。在辅助标签页添加后，它可以渲染你的预览让训练不再为此暂停、在你需要用电脑时接管训练（运行卡片上的“移动到…”），或与你的 GPU 分摊每个 epoch 的训练。

分摊时每块 GPU 在自己那部分图片上训练各自的 LoRA 副本，每次合并时把副本的变化并入同一个 LoRA：实测相似度与单 GPU 运行相当。快速网络上每个 epoch 合并一次最接近单机结果。长训练收益最大。在 pod 上训练？家里的 GPU 可以帮忙，检查点保存时即送回家。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image likeness sooner, and Base previews with the SFT look
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image 相似度更早到来，基础版预览带上 SFT 外观

phrases.en:
A new Clean-end share default for MOSS-Image, Slide, brings likeness in early and keeps it: on our most difficult dataset it was the best of eight settings we tried.

Give Base previews the SFT look (Samples tab) gives your Base previews much of SFT's look with no model swap. We still recommend leaving the Turbo LoRA off for previews. And update ComfyUI: many people's Fizgig LoRAs work better since its latest update.
phrases.zh:
MOSS-Image 的新默认干净端占比“滑降”让相似度早到且保持：在我们最难的数据集上它是八种设置中的最佳。

“给基础版预览 SFT 外观”（样本标签页）让基础版预览无需换模型即获得 SFT 的大部分观感。我们仍建议预览关闭 Turbo LoRA。另外请更新 ComfyUI：自其最新更新以来许多人的 Fizgig LoRA 效果更好了。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image Turbo previews: fast, but don't judge likeness on them
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image Turbo 预览：快，但别用它评判相似度

phrases.en:
The MOSS-Image Turbo LoRAs aren't mature yet: they can reduce likeness a lot in previews. Use them to check a run is on track quickly, then judge likeness on full-quality previews: set Turbo LoRA strength to 0 on the Samples tab (Steps and CFG go back with it). The gallery's Turbo line now says this too.

New for every model: How often to preview and How often to save. Preview every 5 epochs, say, then from epoch 10 every epoch.
phrases.zh:
MOSS-Image 的 Turbo LoRA 尚未成熟：可能在预览中大幅降低相似度。可用它快速确认训练在正轨上，然后在全质量预览上评判相似度：在样本标签页把 Turbo LoRA 强度设为 0（步数和 CFG 随之恢复）。图库的 Turbo 行现在也会这样提示。

所有模型新增：预览频率和保存频率。比如先每 5 个 epoch 预览，然后从 epoch 10 起每个 epoch 预览。

phrases.en: civarchive mirror of the Civitai page
phrases.zh: Civitai 页面的 civarchive 镜像

phrases.en: Kromoss out as a preview model
phrases.zh: Kromoss 不再作为预览模型

phrases.en:
Kromoss is no longer offered as the MOSS-Image preview model: it's too different from MOSS-Image Base for reliable previews of a LoRA trained on Base, and as a base to train on it overcooks. If you set Kromoss on the preview model or Base DiT row, press Download models for me in Preferences: it points both back to SFT and MOSS-Image Base.

The 8-step Turbo LoRA stays, for fast previews of your Base: untick Use the SFT model for samples and set Turbo LoRA strength to 1 (12 steps).
phrases.zh:
Kromoss 不再作为 MOSS-Image 的预览模型提供：它与 MOSS-Image 基础版差异太大，无法为在基础版上训练的 LoRA 提供可靠预览；作为训练基座又容易过火。如果你在预览模型或基础 DiT 行设置了 Kromoss，请在偏好设置中按“为我下载模型”：它会把两者都指回 SFT 和 MOSS-Image 基础版。

8 步 Turbo LoRA 保留，用于基础版的快速预览：取消勾选“样本使用 SFT 模型”并把 Turbo LoRA 强度设为 1（12 步）。

phrases.en: MOSS-Image LoRAs now learn likeness much sooner, and the picture holds its composition from epoch to epoch. MOSS's own schedule put only about 11% of training steps where faces and detail are learned; Fizgig's new Clean-end share puts 30% there. By eye the pictures are far sharper and more accurate, with no body horror. It's the default: there's nothing to set.
phrases.zh: MOSS-Image LoRA 现在能更早学会相似度，且画面构图在 epoch 之间保持稳定。MOSS 自身的调度只把约 11% 的训练步放在人脸与细节的学习区间；Fizgig 新的干净端占比把 30% 放在那里。目测图片远更锐利、更准确，没有肢体扭曲。它已是默认设置：无需任何配置。

phrases.re: ^How a clip in the dataset enters the mod\. Sharpest still: one frame, the face.{1,3}the identity choice\. Motion: every latent frame of the clip, the node pack's video reference \(a dance, a camera move\); tokens are per frame, so a clip costs its length\. Prepare clips with Gizmo first.{1,3}cut to H3's frame grid at the right size, they work best\.$
phrases.zh: 数据集中的片段如何进入 mod。最清晰静帧：单帧、人脸 —— 身份之选。动态：片段的每个潜帧，节点包的视频参考（一段舞、一个运镜）；token 按帧计费，片段的成本即其长度。请先用 Gizmo 准备片段 —— 按 H3 帧网格剪到合适尺寸，效果最好。

phrases.re: ^Text conditioning: Qwen3\.5-9B's final hidden state through the chat template with an open .*?block, unpadded, up to 4096 tokens\. Keep the text encoder frozen\.$
phrases.zh: 文本条件化：Qwen3.5-9B 经对话模板的最终隐状态，带未闭合的 <|block|>、不填充、至多 4096 token。保持文本编码器冻结。

phrases.re: ^A\ shortcut:\ the\ folders\ in\ (.+?),\ and\ the\ ones\ you've\ picked\ from\ anywhere\ else\ \(outlined\)\.\ Click\ one\ to\ make\ it\ the\ training\ folder\ above\.\ For\ a\ folder\ that\ isn't\ listed\ \(another\ drive,\ or\ a\ subfolder\),\ press\ Choose…\ above;\ to\ add\ a\ new\ one,\ upload\ it\ below\.$
phrases.zh: 快捷方式：$1 中的文件夹，以及你从其他位置挑选的（有边框）。点击一个即可将其设为上方的训练文件夹。对于未列出的文件夹（另一个驱动器或子文件夹），请按上方的“选择…”；要添加新的，请在下方上传。

phrases.re: ^(.+?)\ of\ the\ (.+?)\ photos\ already\ have\ a\ caption\.\\s*$

phrases.en: Trained on only when Also train on its sub-folders is ticked on the Training tab
phrases.zh: 仅当“训练”标签页勾选“同时训练其子文件夹”时才参与训练

phrases.en: Its sub-folders are kept, as Also train on its sub-folders is ticked on the Training tab.
phrases.zh: 其子文件夹会保留，因为“训练”标签页勾选了“同时训练其子文件夹”。

phrases.en: Puts the folders and inference settings above back to Fizgig's defaults. Model files, the web password and the RunPod key are kept.
phrases.zh: 将上述文件夹和推理设置恢复为 Fizgig 默认值。模型文件、网页密码和 RunPod 密钥会保留。

phrases.en: These files are gated: sign in to Hugging Face, accept the licence on each page below, then paste a read token. It is used for this download only, never saved. Leave it empty when the machine or pod has HF_TOKEN set.
phrases.zh: 这些文件受许可限制：登录 Hugging Face、在下方各页面接受许可，然后粘贴只读 token。它仅用于本次下载、从不保存。机器或 pod 已设置 HF_TOKEN 时留空。

phrases.re: ^Fetches\ every\ file\ above\ \(\~(.+?)\ GB\)\ and\ fills\ in\ these\ paths,\ plus\ the\ Qwen3\-VL\ captioner\ the\ Captions\ tab\ uses\ and\ the\ small\ face\ and\ captioning\ models\.\ Interrupted\ downloads\ resume\ where\ they\ left\ off\.$
phrases.zh: 获取上述所有文件（约 $1 GB）并填好这些路径，还包括“标注”标签页用的 Qwen3-VL 标注器以及小型人脸与标注模型。中断的下载会从断点继续。

phrases.en: Where uploaded training data goes, each upload in its own folder inside it, and where the folder pickers start. Leave it empty for Fizgig's own training_data folder.
phrases.zh: 上传训练数据的存放位置，每次上传在其中各自一个文件夹，也是文件夹选择器的起点。留空则使用 Fizgig 自带的 training_data 文件夹。

phrases.en: Your files: datasets in /workspace/datasets, models in /workspace/models, finished LoRAs in /workspace/output_loras. They survive stopping and starting the instance, and go when you destroy it. A stopped instance may not start again while someone else rents its GPU.
phrases.zh: 你的文件：数据集在 /workspace/datasets，模型在 /workspace/models，完成的 LoRA 在 /workspace/output_loras。它们会随实例停止和启动而保留，销毁实例时才会消失。已停止的实例在别人租用其 GPU 期间可能无法再启动。

phrases.en: Only after a run completes on its own - never after a pause, a stop or a failure, and with a queue only after its last run. A two-minute countdown you can cancel comes first, on any page. It stops the pod, never terminates it, so your files are still here when you start it again.
phrases.zh: 仅在运行自行完成后 —— 绝不在暂停、停止或失败后，有队列时仅在其最后一次运行后。会先在任何页面弹出可取消的两分钟倒计时。它只停止 pod、从不终止，再次启动时文件仍在。

phrases.en: Password: this pod's FIZGIG_PASSWORD from the template, or the one the pod made up and printed in its log on its first start.
phrases.zh: 密码：此 pod 模板中的 FIZGIG_PASSWORD，或 pod 首次启动时自行生成并打印在日志中的那个。

phrases.en: Empty: the web UI opens on this machine only. Set (8 characters or more): other devices can open it too, after logging in. Whoever has it can use Fizgig and open files on this machine, so treat it like a remote-desktop password. Saved in prefs.json as plain text.
phrases.zh: 留空：Web 界面仅在本机打开。设置后（至少 8 个字符）：其他设备登录后也可打开。持有者可使用 Fizgig 并打开本机文件，请像对待远程桌面密码一样对待它。以明文保存在 prefs.json。

phrases.re: ^Fizgig\ moves\ to\ port\ (.+?)\ next\ time\ it\ starts\ \(this\ page\ is\ on\ (.+?)\ until\ then\)\.\ If\ that\ port\ is\ taken,\ it\ uses\ the\ next\ free\ one\ above\ it\.$

phrases.en: Renders on the model most people generate with (the default). The Samples tab's previews are on your Base
phrases.zh: 在大多数人用来生成的模型上渲染（默认）。“样本”标签页的预览在你的基座上

phrases.zh: 从工作室下次加载起生效，以及下次竞技场或分析器渲染（模型会重新加载，所以那次更久）

phrases.zh: 预览 $1 步，CFG $2 —— 取自该模型的“样本”标签页。

phrases.zh: 它已在 $1 上$2（那里的日志说明了原因）。把它带回即可从上次保存处在此继续。

phrases.re: ^For\ a\ (.+?)\ that\ won't\ come\ back\ \(a\ pod\ deleted\):\ carries\ on\ here\ from\ this\ computer's\ last\ save\ \-\ the\ epochs\ it\ trained\ there\ are\ lost\.\ It's\ stopped\ there\ if\ it\ still\ answers$
phrases.zh: 对于回不来的 $1（pod 已删除）：在此从本机上次保存处继续 —— 在那里训练的 epoch 会丢失。若它仍有响应，则在那里停止

phrases.en: Peak ArcFace is about 72%: that's what two photos of the same person score against each other, so no picture reaches 100%.
phrases.zh: ArcFace 的峰值约为 72%：这是同一人两张照片互评的分数，因此没有图片能达到 100%。

phrases.en: A run is training now: this one is on the queue, and continues when its turn comes.
phrases.zh: 当前有运行正在训练：本次在队列中，轮到它时会继续。

phrases.re: ^Trains\ on\ from\ its\ newest\ save\ \((.+?)\ (.+?)\),\ with\ this\ run's\ own\ settings,\ into\ this\ same\ run$
phrases.zh: 从最新保存处继续训练（$1 $2），用本次运行自己的设置，写入同一运行

phrases.re: ^Deletes\ (.+?)\ \-\ (.+?)\ from\ (.+?)\ \-\ for\ good,\ and\ takes\ the\ run\ off\ this\ list\.$
phrases.zh: 永久删除 $1 —— $2，来自 $3 —— 并把该运行从列表中移除。

phrases.en: No runs yet. Every run you start is listed here with its results.
phrases.zh: 暂无运行。你启动的每次运行都会连同结果列在这里。

phrases.en: Edit caption fixes one while the run goes: the trainer re-encodes it at the next epoch and that image's history starts again - it should turn blue (learning) if the fix worked.
phrases.zh: 训练进行中“编辑标注”可即时修正：训练器会在下一个 epoch 重新编码它，该图的历史重新开始 —— 若修复生效，它应变蓝（学习中）。

phrases.zh: 蓝色是 LoRA 学到的内容；尚未保存。再按一次看另外两张（已看 $1 / $2）。

phrases.re: ^Blank:\ Fdetailer\ if\ it's\ saved\ as\ (.+?),\ otherwise\ a\ free\ anime\ head\ finder\ that\ downloads\ the\ first\ time\ it's\ used\.\ docs/FACE_BACKENDS\.md\ explains\ how\ to\ get\ Fdetailer\.$
phrases.zh: 留空：若已存为 $1 则用 Fdetailer，否则用一个免费的动漫头部查找器，首次使用时下载。docs/FACE_BACKENDS.md 说明了如何获取 Fdetailer。

phrases.en: Optional: photos the clip starts and ends on (a still uses the first only), each cropped to the clip's shape - you place the crop when you pick one.
phrases.zh: 可选：片段的首帧和末帧照片（静图只用第一张），各自裁剪成片段形状 —— 选择时由你摆放裁剪。

phrases.en: Windows Firewall doesn't let your phone in yet. Allow Fizgig on your network (private networks only), then the QR code appears here.
phrases.zh: Windows 防火墙尚未允许你的手机接入。在网络上允许 Fizgig（仅专用网络）后，二维码会显示在这里。

phrases.re: ^Starting\ (.+?):\ it\ opens\ here\ when\ it's\ ready\.\ A\ pod\ can\ take\ a\ few\ minutes\ to\ start;\ if\ it\ isn't\ ready\ after\ that,\ check\ it\ on\ RunPod\ \(its\ Logs\ show\ what\ it's\ doing\)\.$
phrases.zh: 正在启动 $1：就绪后会在这里打开。pod 启动可能需要几分钟；若之后仍未就绪，请在 RunPod 上检查（其日志会显示进展）。

phrases.en: Off: the helper gets the training folder and makes the cache itself (with this run's own VAE and text encoder), much less to send. On: this computer's cache goes over instead - for a fast link
phrases.zh: 关闭：辅助机接收训练文件夹并自行制作缓存（用本次运行自己的 VAE 和文本编码器），需传输的少得多。开启：改为传输本机缓存 —— 适合快速链路

phrases.zh: 开启：本次运行的第一个 epoch 会等辅助机就绪（模型已加载、缓存已做好或已发送），双方从一开始就一起训练。关闭：本机立即开始，辅助机就绪后在下一轮加入

phrases.zh: 预览开启时：本次运行的下一个预览轮会在此处和辅助机上同时渲染，两者互相比对（相同设置应产生相同图片）

phrases.en: The helper downloads them now, from Hugging Face, so the first job doesn't wait for them
phrases.zh: 辅助机现在就从 Hugging Face 下载它们，免得第一个任务等待

phrases.en: Time a few pieces each way, as a training share sends them
phrases.zh: 按训练分摊时的传输方式，双向各测几块数据

phrases.en: Your broadband's upload and download in Mb/s, if the measure fails or looks wrong
phrases.zh: 你的宽带上行和下行（Mb/s），用于测量失败或结果明显不对时

phrases.en: In use as a helper (below, under Your helpers)
